Du er god til at opbygge relationer, trives i et tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger og kan lide at gøre undervisningen nærværende og levende. Vi har alle lidt kant – det har du også!

Hvad tilbyder vi? På Alkestrupskolen bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, søde børn og plads til forskellighed:

  • Stærkt kollegafællesskab: Du bliver en del af en engageret personalegruppe, hvor vi løfter i flok, passer på hinanden, og hvor der er plads til faglighed og udvikling - og til at være præcis den, du er.
  • Overskuelige rammer: En mindre skole, hvor alle børn og voksne kender hinanden.
  • Opbakning og natur: En meget engageret forældrekreds samt fantastiske udearealer og natur, der oplagt kan inddrages i undervisningen.

Det praktiske:

  • Arbejdstid: Fuldtid
  • Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt.
  • Ansøgning: Vi opfordrer dig til at tage kontakt til enten Souschef Christopher Folkvard tlf.: 51 16 68 22 eller skoleleder Merete Fledelius tlf.: 24 91 76 32 for et besøg på skolen fra uge 39 og frem.
  • Send din ansøgning: Vi foretrækker, at du sender din ansøgning online. Klik på ”Søg stillingen” og vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV.
  • Ansættelsessamtaler: Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

I Køge Kommune bliver du en del af en organisation med dedikerede medarbejdere, der hver dag forenes i et fælles mål om at skabe værdi for borgerne. I kommunen ser vi mangfoldighed som en ressource, og ønsker at fremme ligestillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge stillingen – uanset køn, etnisk oprindelse, religion, alder eller eventuel funktionsnedsættelse.

Så bliv en del af holdet! Vi tilbyder dig et forskelligartet arbejdsmiljø og en lang række forskellige personalegoder, såsom sociale aktiviteter og adgang til vores feriehuse.

Læs mere om Køge Kommune på www.koege.dk

title: Montør til Bruseglas og nicher
description:
Er du en kvalitetsbevidst tømrer eller håndværker med sans for detaljen? Trives du med selvstændigt arbejde, hvor du får ansvar og frihed i hverdagen? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en dygtig medarbejder med håndværker erfaring til montering af bruseglas og nicher hos primært erhvervskunder på hele Sjælland. Du behøver ikke at være uddannet så længe du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på.

Erfaring med montagearbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du arbejder præcist, leverer høj kvalitet og sætter en ære i godt håndværk. Du vil få en grundig oplæring, hvor du de første 1½ måned følges med en erfaren kollega.

Du starter arbejdsdagen hjemmefra og modtager dagen før en arbejdsplan med dagens opgaver. Materialer hentes på vores lager i Roskilde cirka to gange om ugen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling med opstart hurtigst muligt.

  • Arbejde mandag til torsdag kl. 07.30–15.30 og fredag kl. 07.30–15.00.

  • Timeløn på 225 kr. Ved fastansættelse vil lønnen være højere.

  • Firmabil, værktøj, arbejdstøj og mobiltelefon stilles til rådighed.

  • Grundig oplæring og sparring med en erfaren kollega.

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse efter 3 måneders fuldtidsansættelse

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er bosat på Sjælland og kommer med noget håndværksmæssig erfaring.

  • Har gerne erfaring med montagearbejde eller fugning.

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for detaljen.

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Taler dansk eller engelsk.

  • Har kørekort B.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdsområde: Hele Sjælland (lager i Roskilde)

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt – vi ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag til Niso@moment.dk. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Material Coordinator
description:
Brænder du for koordinering, logistik og materialestyring? Er du struktureret, serviceminded og trives med mange kontaktflader i en dynamisk hverdag? Så er du måske vores nye Material Coordinator.

Rolle og ansvarsområder

Som Material Coordinator bliver du en vigtig del af OMC-teamet, hvor du får en central rolle i at sikre effektiv håndtering af materialer, udstyr og logistiske processer mellem offshore-installationer, varehus, indkøb, leverandører og interne interessenter.

Stillingen er på 30 timer.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Håndtering og koordinering af backload-processer mellem offshore og onshore lokationer.

  • Opfølgning på leveringstider og dialog med indkøb om fremrykning af materialer.

  • Koordinering med bådtransport og varehus ved modtagelse og afsendelse af materialer.

  • Sikre hurtig returnering af lejeudstyr til leverandører.

  • Oprettelse og koordinering af serviceordrer til reparation af udstyr, herunder:

  • Assistere med lukning af Repair-ordrer for at sikre korrekt håndtering af økonomiske commitments.

  • Rådgivning og support ved spørgsmål omkring materialerouting til offshore-destinationer.

  • Sparringspartner for Unisol-teamet i forbindelse med forbedringer, fejl og optimering af SAP-processer.

  • Oprettelse af manuelle Purchase Requisitions til materialeindkøb.

  • Opfølgning på kvalitetskontrol (QC) for frigivelse af materialer i samarbejde med indkøb og leverandører.

  • Gennemføre materialegennemgang på kampagnebåde samt koordinere pick/pack-aktiviteter med planlæggere, varehus og bådpersonale.

  • Opfølgning på hasteordrer og kritiske materialebehov fra offshore.

  • Koordinering af reparationer på udstyr modtaget fra offshoreinstallationer.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af transporter via vejtransport.

 

Hvem er du?

  • Har erfaring inden for logistik, supply chain, materialestyring eller lagerfunktioner

  • Har erfaring med SAP eller tilsvarende ERP-systemer

  • Er struktureret og god til at holde overblik over mange opgaver samtidigt

  • Trives med koordinering på tværs af flere afdelinger og interessenter

  • Er løsningsorienteret og har en proaktiv tilgang til opgaver

  • Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og god kundeservice

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag i et dynamisk miljø.

  • Tæt samarbejde med offshore, indkøb, lager, logistik og teknikere.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og stor indflydelse på arbejdsprocesser.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på samarbejde, videndeling og kontinuerlige forbedringer.

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Deltidsstilling 30 timer, med 1 ugentlig fridag i rul med resten af teamet.

Om NorSea

House of Offshore Innovation er et kontorfællesskab med både nationale og internationale virksomheder fra energiindustrien. Vi udlejer kontor- og mødelokaler og deler husets ressourcer og viden med hinanden.

NorSea Denmark er en del af NorSea Group, og er ejet af Wilhelmsen. Vi opererer Danmarks største offshore supply base. Gennem vores one-stop-shop koncept servicerer vi energisektoren med totale supply chain løsninger.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, der hele tiden forsøger at udvikle os gennem innovation. Vores vigtigste aktiv er vores medarbejdere, og vi har det som vores mission at være Best Place to Work. Vi bor i vores nyrenoverede domicil, House of Offshore Innovation i Esbjerg. Hér tilbyder vi vores medarbejdere attraktive vilkår, herunder; personalerestaurant, fitnesslokale, aktiv personaleforening m.m.

NorSea Denmark is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to the maritime and offshore industry. The group operates 12 supply bases in the North Sea, and our base in Esbjerg is Denmark’s largest. We are part of the NorSea Group - a global provider of base operations and full service logistics solutions with 50 years of experience.

NorSea Group is owned by one of the world’s largest maritime industrial group, Wilhelmsen. As an experienced and reliable one-stop-shop, we at NorSea Denmark aim to set new industry standards for efficiency and safety. We deliver all types of logistics and base solutions to the offshore sector. With a deep understanding of our customers’ commercial interests and needs, we innovate safe and profitable solutions.

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at blive en vigtig del af forsyningskæden og sikre, at de rette materialer er tilgængelige på rette tid og sted? Så ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Michael Zdrinka Clausen, Warehouse Manager på michael.clausen@norseagroup.com eller +45 21946317

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. oktober eller når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Construction Worker / Bygningsarbejder søges til Hanse Byg ApS, Nordfyn

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV to job@vejentil.dk with "Construction Worker" in the subject line. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found.

title: KS3 and IGCSE English Teacher (Year 7 – Year 11)
description:
International School Ikast-Brande (ISIB) is looking for a qualified Cambridge English teacher with experience teaching English to students from Year 7 – Year 11. Preference will be given to candidates who have experience teaching IGCSE First Language English and are native speakers. Interviews will be arranged immediately as the Leadership Team would like to recruit as soon as possible.  

This is a full-time, permanent & pensionable position starting as soon as possible. As an inclusive school, we encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We value the richness that diverse perspectives and lived experiences bring to our community, and we are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where every individual feels respected and supported.  

 

The School: 

International School Ikast-Brande is located in the heart of Denmark and has approximately 200 students across Early Years, Primary and Secondary sections, with one class per year group. Our students are highly motivated and speak very positively about the school. We are committed to providing high-quality international education to families relocating to Denmark, as well as to local families seeking a rigorous international curriculum for their children.  

Our student body is wonderfully diverse, representing a wide range of nationalities and cultural backgrounds. We encourage our students to balance academic achievement with a well-rounded, healthy lifestyle. From an early age, we instil in them a strong sense of right and wrong, empowering them to make thoughtful and responsible decisions. As a result, we enjoy a positive school climate with very few behavioural issues.  

Our teaching team is as vibrant and international as our student body. You will often hear laughter coming from our staffroom and in the corridors. Our team meets regularly to collaborate on educational and operational matters, fostering a collegial and supportive environment.  

 

Requirements: 

In line with the school’s overarching policies and procedures, the successful candidate will be expected to: 

  • Plan and develop engaging & high-quality lessons, tailored to our learners’ needs; 

  • Maintain a student-focused, positive approach to teaching and learning; 

  • Deliver dynamic, stimulating and culturally engaging lessons;  

  • Promote student wellbeing through an understanding of each child’s individuality;  

  • Assess and report on students’ progress effectively;  

  • Manage student behaviour in a positive and constructive manner;  

  • Participate actively in whole-school activities and events;  

  • Employ a solutions-focused mindset;  

  • Maintain a great sense of humour and contribute to a positive work environment;  

  • Be internationally minded and a collaborative team player. 

 

What We Can Offer: 

  • A competitive salary and excellent pension scheme, in line with collective agreements; 

  • A genuine and sustainable work-life balance; 

  • State-of-the-art, modern teaching and learning facilities; 

  • Small class sizes with engaged, capable and curious students; 

  • A calm and respectful learning environment, with motivated and well-disciplined pupils; 

  • A flexible working culture, built on mutual trust and professional autonomy; 

  • A supportive and visible Senior Leadership Team, deeply committed to staff and community wellbeing; 

  • A leadership approach that values collaboration, open dialogue and teacher voice - ensuring staff feel heard, empowered and appreciated; 

  • A culturally diverse, inclusive and welcoming team of professionals; 

  • Strong, constructive partnerships with engaged and supportive parents; 

  • Ongoing professional learning, development opportunities and team-building events. 

 

What Denmark Can Offer: 

Living and working in Denmark offers a unique opportunity to enjoy one of the world’s highest standards of living. Teachers benefit from: 

  • An excellent work-life balance supported by a strong social welfare system; 

  • A safe, clean and well-organised society with low levels of crime; 

  • High-quality, publicly funded healthcare and childcare services; 

  • A focus on family life, personal wellbeing and professional respect; 

  • Beautiful natural surroundings; 

  • Easy access to travel across Denmark, Europe and further afield; 

  • An international community that welcomes newcomers and supports integration; 

  • A strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. 

 

Salary: 

Salary and pension are determined in accordance with the collective agreement and union contract established between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Teachers’ Central Organisation. 

Please note that both local and international teachers are employed under the same pay scales and working conditions. 

While the school does not offer formal relocation packages, we are committed to supporting new staff and work closely with individuals to find practical and helpful solutions throughout their transition. To further assist international staff with their move, initial relocation support is provided during the first year of employment. 

 

Application: 

If you are a skilled, adaptable and solutions-oriented educator, we warmly invite you to apply by sending your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience to job@isib.dk. Letters of recommendation are also welcomed. All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory police security checks.   

The Senior Leadership Team intends to appoint as soon as a suitable candidate is identified to ensure a smooth transition to our school; therefore, interviews will take place on a rolling basis, and the school reserves the right to make an appointment before the advertised closing date.

title: Frederik på 8 år i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                
 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag


  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Send dit CV samt en kort motiveret ansøgning til:

title: PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING
description:
PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING

Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

About the position

We are looking for a reliable and motivated Production Operator to join our production team. You will work with rolling of metal components and operation of an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine. You do not need to be a qualified welder or have a formal vocational education. The most important things are a good technical understanding, a willingness to learn, attention to quality and the ability to work safely and responsibly.

Your main responsibilities

Ø  Operate rolling machines and production equipment.

Ø  Operate and monitor an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine.

Ø  Set up and make minor adjustments to machines and equipment.

Ø  Monitor the production process and ensure stable production.

Ø  Carry out basic dimensional and visual quality checks.

Ø  Identify deviations and report problems to the team leader or supervisor.

Ø  Keep your workplace clean, organized and safe.

Ø  Follow company procedures for quality, safety and production.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be formally trained as a welder or have a vocational qualification. We are looking for someone who:

Ø  Has experience from manufacturing, metalworking, machine operation or a similar production environment – experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ø  Has a good technical understanding and enjoys working with machines.

Ø  Is practical, reliable and willing to learn.

Ø  Can work independently but also contributes positively to the team.

Ø  Has a strong focus on quality and safety.

Ø  Is comfortable with repetitive production tasks and physical work.

Ø  Can understand basic instructions, measurements and simple technical information.

Ø  Is able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Training and introduction

Full training will be provided. You will receive a structured introduction to the machines, production processes, quality requirements and safety procedures. Previous experience with automatic welding or rolling is therefore not essential.

What we offer

A stable position in a modern production environment.

Thorough training and support from experienced colleagues.

A practical and varied working day.

A workplace where safety, quality and teamwork are important.

Good opportunities to develop your technical skills and take on more responsibility over time.

Competitive salary and employment conditions according to qualifications and experience.

Working environment

You will become part of a team where we value cooperation, respect and a good working atmosphere. We believe that good production results are created by people who work together, help each other and take responsibility for their work.

Working hours

The position is day shift and 37 hours / week

Location

Tcomp | Tjæreborg Kompensatorfabrik A/S,  Kærvej 19, 6731 Tjæreborg, Denmark

 

How to apply

About us

Tcomp is a Danish manufacturing company based in Tjæreborg, near Esbjerg. We specialize in metal production and manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and reliable solutions for our customers.

We are a hands-on company where teamwork, safety and respect for each other are important parts of everyday life. We believe that good results are created by skilled and committed people working together.

På det andet øje er synet betydeligt påvirket af fremskreden aldersrelateret degeneration af den gule plet (AMD).

 

Hun har derfor behov for en stabil, omsorgsfuld og tryg person, som kan støtte hende i dagligdagen og hjælpe med både personlige og praktiske opgaver, så hun fortsat kan have en værdig, tryg og så selvstændig hverdag som muligt i sit eget hjem.

-              At hjælpe med praktiske opgaver i hjemmet og skabe struktur i hverdagen

-              At yde personlig støtte og hjælp efter behov

-              At ledsage og støtte ved indkøb, gåture og andre daglige aktiviteter

-              At være med til at skabe tryghed og sikkerhed i hjemmet

-              At være opmærksom på hendes behov og kommunikere tydeligt og respektfuldt

-              At bidrage til en hyggelig positiv hverdag

Vi forventer at du:

-              Har en relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for pleje og omsorg

-              Er tålmodig, empatisk og omsorgsfuld

-              Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

-              Er mødestabil og fleksibel

-              Har forståelse for de udfordringer, der kan være forbundet med nedsat syn

-              Er god til at kommunikere og skabe tryg relation

-              Har en positiv indstilling og lyst til at gøre en forskel

-              Kan tale persisk (farsi) eller armensk

Det er vigtigt, at du møder klienten med respekt og nærvær og har lyst til at blive en stabil og tryg del af hendes hverdag. Borgerens selvbestemmelse skal til enhver tid respekteres.

Vi tilbyder:

-              Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

title: Pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Naturly – 37 timer
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for unge – også når dagen ikke går helt efter planen?

Naturly søger en pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt på vores børne- og ungehjem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe ro, struktur, relation og udvikling omkring unge, som har brug for voksne, der både kan stå fast og være nysgerrige på det, der ligger bag en adfærd.

Hvem er vi?

Naturly er et mindre, privat børne- og ungehjem med 5 pladser efter Barnets Lov § 43 samt 1 fleksibel plads efter Servicelovens § 107.

Vores målgruppe er unge i alderen 12–22 år, som blandt andet kan have ADHD/opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser, angst, stressbelastning, tilknytningsvanskeligheder og erfaringer med omsorgssvigt.

Vi arbejder med KRAP som pædagogisk metode samt en mentaliserende og strukturpædagogisk tilgang.

Hos os skal faglighed ikke kun stå i en metodebeskrivelse. Den skal kunne ses i hverdagen, i relationen til den unge, i vores refleksioner og i vores dokumentation.

Vi søger dig, der

er uddannet pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og som har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med unge, kolleger og ledelse.

Du må gerne have erfaring fra døgnområdet eller med vores målgruppe, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, stabil, ansvarlig og fagligt reflekterende.

Du skal kunne bevare roen, når en ung har svært ved det, være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden, og samtidig være tydelig omkring de rammer, der skaber tryghed og forudsigelighed.

Vi prioriterer din faglige udvikling

På Naturly skal man ikke stå alene med de faglige udfordringer. Vi prioriterer tid til refleksion, sparring og udvikling af vores fælles praksis.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

• Løbende supervision
• Faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
• Faste faglige drøftelser

title: Specialiseret butiksmedarbejder/knivspecialist. Specialist retail assistent - Japanese as working language
description:
Arbejdssted: København Location: Copenhagen

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid 37 timer om ugen. Working hours. Full-time, 37 hours per week.

Ansættelsesform: Fastansættelse Employment: Permanent position.

Om stillingen:

Vi søger en engageret medarbejder til vores specialiserede butik med fokus på japanske kvalitetsknive og japansk knivhåndværk.

Stillingen er en kombination af salg og kundeservice, arbejde med slibning af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen kombinerer salg og kundeservice med praktisk arbejde, slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

En væsentlig del af stillingen indebærer direkte kommunikation med japanske producenter og leverandører. Derfor er gode japanske sprogkundskaber en nødvendighed kompetence i stillingen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Salg og rådgivning af kunder om japanske kvalitetsknive og tilbehør.

Kundeservice og vejledning om valg, brug og vedligeholdelse af knive.

Slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive, samt indgravering i hånden.

Modtagelse, kontrol og håndtering af varer.

Vare- og lagerstyring.

Kommunikation med japanske leverandører og producenter,

Håndtering af profuktinformation, ordrer, specifikationer og leverancer.

Oversættelse og videreformidling af information mellem virksomheden og japanske leverandører.

Bidrage til den daglige drift og præsentation af butikken.

Vi forventer, at du:

Taler og skriver japansk på højt niveau.

Kan kommunikere proffesionelt med vores japanske leverandører både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Har interesse for japanske knive, håndværk og kvalitet.

Har gode kundeservice- og salgsevner.

Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst.

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

Har interesse for eller erfaring med knivslibning.

Behersker engelsk, så du kan kommunikere med kolleger og kunder.

Erfaring med knivslibning, salg eller arbejde med japanske knive er en fordel. Erfaring med håndgravering er ligeledes en fordel. Oplæring i virksomhedens produkter og arbejdsmetoder vil blive givet efter behov.

Japansk er et nødvendigt arbejdssprog, da medarbejderne vil have løbende kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører, vedrørende blandt andet produktinformation, bestillinger, specifikationer og leverancer.

Fast ansættelse på 37 timer om ugen.

En alsidig stilling i en specialiseret butik.

Arbejde med japanske kvalitetsprodukter og knivhåndværk.

Direkte kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører.

Oplæring i produkter, knivtyper og slibeteknikker.

Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og god kundeservice.

Send CV og ansøgning til tess@foodgear.dk.

Fortæl gerne om din baggrund og erfaring med japansk håndværk, samt dine sprogkundskaber.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and service-minded employee to join our specialized shop, focusing on high quality Japanese knives and Japanese knife craftmanship.

A varied position in a specialised retail shop.

The opportunity to work with high-quality Japanese products and traditional knife craftmanship.

Direct contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers.

Training in products, knife types and sharpening techniques.

A working environment focused on quality, expertise and excellent customer service.

title: PhD Stipend in Digital Twin Modelling and Multi-Timescale Optimization of Electrolysis Systems
description:
Help to build the digital backbone of tomorrow's Power-to-X plants. This 3-year PhD position offers a unique opportunity to build a research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems. You will drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies, integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand, to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolysers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University, and research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
You will develop and validate digital-twin and optimization methods for electrolysis systems, working both independently and collaboratively with the group and with academic and industrial partners. In particular, you will:

  • Develop and validate physics-based, data-driven, or hybrid digital twins of Electrolysis systems, capturing their electrochemical, thermal, flow, and system-level behaviour for system monitoring, state estimation, and performance prediction.
  • Build computationally efficient models suitable for monitoring, performance prediction, optimization, and control, and evaluate their accuracy, robustness, computational efficiency, and practical applicability. They could also be implemented in real-time systems.
  • Investigate interactions across operational timescales (Multi-timescale optimization) — from short-term power, thermal, and flow management to longer-term production scheduling and energy-system operation — connecting fast system dynamics with slower operational decisions.
  • Develop optimization strategies to improve Electrolyzer performance, efficiency, flexibility, and economic operation under variable electricity supply and renewable-energy integration.
  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project activities.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies 
We expect you to have:

  • A relevant master's degree in energy engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, control engineering, or a related discipline.
  • A strong foundation in at least one of: electrochemical or energy-system modelling, dynamic modelling and control, mathematical optimization, or data-driven modelling.
  • Experience with numerical modelling, simulation, optimization, control, or engineering-data analysis.
  • Good programming skills in Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or a comparable scientific computing environment.
  • A fundamental understanding of energy-conversion systems, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, heat and mass transfer, electrochemistry, or control engineering.
  • The ability to conduct independent, systematic, and scientifically rigorous research while working effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with some of the areas of electrolyzer technologies, digital twins, model order reduction, system identification, power electronics, model predictive control, multi-objective optimization, machine learning, renewable-energy integration, experimental testing, or hardware-in-the-loop implementation would be an advantage. You are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are
The PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • A project description (3–5 pages) outlining your initial thoughts and ideas on the project applied for, including a brief state-of-the-art with a short list of references, a time schedule, and how you intend to address the project objectives.
  • Publications, if applicable.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

title: Postdoc Position in System Optimization Using Digital Twin for Power-to-X processes
description:
Take the next step in your research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale system optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems with special focus on the electrical engineering parts. This position offers a unique opportunity to drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies—integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power electronic conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand—to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolyzers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University — research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
This two-year postdoctoral project focuses on the system-level integration and optimization of electrolyzer digital twins within CAPeX — considering how component-level electrolyzer models and digital twins can be incorporated into broader Power-to-X systems involving renewable generation, power conversion, power system integration, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand. In particular, you will:

  • Develop an integrated, system-level digital-twin framework connecting electrolyzer models with relevant Power-to-X components and energy-systema.
  • Develop system-level optimization and energy-management methods for coordinating electrolyzers with renewable generation, power conversion, storage, downstream processes, and hydrogen demand.
  • Apply and evaluate these methods under technical constraints and varying renewable generation, electricity prices, and hydrogen demand, considering system efficiency, flexibility, production, and operating costs.
  • Validate and benchmark the developed framework using project data, high-fidelity simulations including hardware in the loop, and relevant industrial case studies, assessing its robustness and computational performance.
  • Collaborate with researchers and industrial partners, contribute to the coordination and supervision of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies
We expect you to have:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in energy-system modelling, mathematical optimization, control, digital twins, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and numerical modelling skills using Python, MATLAB/Simulink, Julia, hardware in the loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as multi-objective optimization, model predictive control, mixed-integer optimization, stochastic optimization, energy management, or production scheduling.
  • Good knowledge of integrated energy systems; experience with electrolyzers, hydrogen technologies, renewable-energy integration, storage, or Power-to-X systems would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be a specialist in every electrolyzer technology or optimization method. Strong system-level modelling and optimization competence, together with the ability to work across component and system boundaries, is particularly important.

Who we are
The position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

For professional questions, please contact Frede Blaabjerg, Professor, fbl@energy.aau.dk, +45 2129 2454.

Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Salary and terms of employment

title: Kontorleder søges
description:
OFFICE MANAGER WANTED FOR OUR OFFICE IN ØSTERBRO

Are you service-minded, organised, and the kind of person who keeps the office running smoothly – even when things get busy?

We are looking for a dedicated Office Manager for a permanent position at our office in Østerbro, Copenhagen.

As our Office Manager, you will be a central part of our day-to-day operations and play an important role in ensuring that the office runs professionally and efficiently.

We operate a staffing agency where the pace can be fast. Phones are ringing, candidates are coming and going, and there are always people, appointments, and tasks that need to be coordinated.

That is why we are looking for someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys working with people, and appreciates a varied working day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be responsible for the day-to-day running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Daily office administration and coordination
• Welcoming candidates, temporary workers, clients, and other visitors
• Answering phone calls and emails
• Managing calendars and coordinating meetings and interviews
• Preparing meeting rooms and office facilities
• Ordering office supplies, refreshments, and other necessities
• Handling post, parcels, and deliveries
• Liaising with suppliers and business partners
• Providing practical support with the onboarding of new employees and temporary workers
• Updating and maintaining administrative information and documents
• Planning internal events and social activities
• Handling administrative and practical ad hoc tasks

You will also be an important source of support for our consultants and management team, helping to create structure and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

WHO ARE YOU?

Above all, we are looking for someone who takes ownership of the office and wants to make a positive difference in the workplace.

You notice what needs to be done, take initiative, and make sure tasks are followed through from start to finish.

We imagine that you:

• Are organised and have a strong sense of overview
• Are outgoing, positive, and service-minded
• Take responsibility and are comfortable working independently
• Enjoy working with people and communicate professionally
• Are able to manage several tasks at the same time
• Thrive in an environment where the day does not always go according to plan
• Have good IT skills
• Communicate confidently in Danish and preferably also in English
• Contribute positively to the atmosphere and sense of community in the office

Previous experience as an Office Manager, receptionist, administrative coordinator, PA, or office assistant is an advantage. However, your personality, way of working, and willingness to take responsibility are just as important to us.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

You will have a permanent base at our office in Østerbro and become an important part of our internal team.

At the same time, we believe in flexibility and freedom with responsibility. Depending on your tasks and by prior agreement, there will therefore be an opportunity to work from home a few days per week. Tasks that require your physical presence will, of course, be carried out from our office in Østerbro.

With us, you can expect a working day filled with people, responsibility, and plenty of variety. There is a short path from idea to action, and you will have the opportunity to shape both your role and the way we run our office.

We offer:

• A permanent position based at our office in Østerbro
• The opportunity to work from home a few days per week
• Flexibility and freedom with responsibility
• A central role with responsibility and influence
• A varied working day
• Close collaboration with both colleagues and management
• An informal, fast-paced working environment
• Opportunities for professional and personal development

Location: Østerbro, Copenhagen / opportunity to work from home
Position: Full-time
Start date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks
  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.


Qualifications
We are seeking a candidate who has:
  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.


Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.


The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:
  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.


Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.



Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.



Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
Want to work with sustainability and software? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you.

We are looking for a software developer to join us to develop and maintain our digital platforms as we scale.

We do drone-based emissions monitoring across oil & gas, maritime, waste management, and other industries. By helping operators safely identify methane leaks and quantify emissions, we're proud to be supporting industry efforts to improve environmental performance while enhancing operational efficiency and asset integrity. We measure greenhouse gas emissions data from various sources and combining them with atmospheric data. Based on scientific methods we then quantify emissions and visualize the data to provide emissions intelligence to operations enabling actions on emissions.

We have a strong focus on R&D, and we are exploring new cutting-edge technologies and ideas to innovate what we can do within emissions monitoring.

The job

You will be part of a small, talented tech developer team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our digital platforms, which are the core of the products we deliver to customers.

As a Software Developer your responsibilities will include:

  • Co-development of our main applications Microsoft Azure, Blazor Server Application (C#)

  • Co-development of our calculation engine, Microsoft Azure Function (Python)

  • Develop new, more appealing user experiences aimed at different user groups to view products and services.

  • Maintain databases, application services and reporting landscape specific to the European maritime emission monitoring set-up.

  • Improve analysis tools and the user experience for the customers, the drone pilot and the internal project manager in collaboration with the project manager running the campaigns.

About you

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

  • A bachelor's degree or master’s degree in engineering, data science, software design, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar

  • Experience with code development in C# and Python and preferable Rust

  • Experience with database design (SQL)

  • Familiar with software development processes in Azure DevOps

  • Experience with development of user interfaces and UX design is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Fluent in English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Genuine interest in technology and IT infrastructure

  • Structured and focused on delivering quality work and being a good team player.

 

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact on cutting industrial emissions

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance

  • Software ownership early on, with senior developers to learn from

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

  • A supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

  • Job location is just north of Copenhagen in Virum, Denmark.

Application and information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we will be evaluating applications on an ongoing basis. Application deadline is 18 October 2026. Expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Please send your application, including your motivation and what a competence you bring, together with your CV to jobs@explicit.dk. Write “Software developer” in the subject field.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Ebdrup, Chief Digital Officer at reb@explicit.dk

___________________________________________________________________________________

About Explicit

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish green tech company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industries. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. Read more about what we do at explicit.dk

title: CNC- Svarvare
description:
CNC-svarvare sökes - pendla enkelt från Sverige till Helsingör

Är du van att arbeta med CNC-maskiner och värdesätter kvalitet och precision i ditt arbete? Då kanske du är den vi söker. Trelleborg Sealing Solutions i Helsingör söker CNC-svarvare till flera lediga tjänster i produktionen med start så snart som möjligt. Låter det intressant?

Fabriken ligger bara en kort resa över Öresund, och flera av våra medarbetare pendlar redan dagligen från Sverige. Från Helsingborg tar färjeöverfarten cirka 20 minuter, och arbetsplatsen ligger nära färjeterminalen i Helsingör.

Hos oss får du arbeta med CNC-svarvning, uppställning, kvalitetskontroll och löpande kompetensutveckling i en internationell industrikoncern med stark lokal förankring.

Vad innebär tjänsten?
Du blir en del av svarvavdelningen på Trelleborg Sealing Solutions, där vi tillverkar tätningslösningar i plastmaterial, främst PTFE, till industrin. Avdelningen består av cirka 80 kollegor med stor yrkeserfarenhet, och många har arbetat hos oss under lång tid.

Vi arbetar i fasta skift, har en stark sammanhållning och erbjuder en grundlig introduktion så att du blir trygg i våra maskiner, processer och kvalitetskrav.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara:
. Verktygsuppsättning samt anpassning och justering av CNC-program
. Uppställning och körning av CNC-svarvar
. Kvalitetskontroller med manuella mätinstrument och visionssystem
. Elektronisk registrering och dokumentation av kvalitetskontroller

Arbetstider:
.    Dagsskift: Måndag - torsdag kl. 07.00-15.15, Fredag kl. 07.00-13.00
.    Kvällsskift: Måndag - torsdag kl. 15.10-22.40, Fredag kl. 12.55-16.55
.    Nattskift (4-dagarsvecka): Måndag - torsdag kl. 22.35-07.05

Vem är du?
Du kan vara utbildad industritekniker, CNC-tekniker eller ha motsvarande erfarenhet från skärande bearbetning. Det viktigaste är att du har god teknisk och matematisk förståelse, arbetar noggrant med hög precision och har erfarenhet av CNC-svarvning. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla dina kompetenser kontinuerligt och ta större ansvar i takt med att du blir mer erfaren i rollen.

Vi ser gärna att du:
.    Har erfarenhet av uppställning och körning av CNC-svarvar
.    Har god teknisk förståelse och god kännedom om verktyg och maskiner
.    Kan läsa och förstå tekniska ritningar samt arbeta med mått, toleranser och relevanta beräkningar
. Arbetar kvalitetsmedvetet och bidrar positivt till samarbetet i vardagen
. Trivs med att arbeta i fasta skift
. Förstår och kan kommunicera på danska eller svenska

Vilka är vi?
Vi är mer än 300 engagerade kollegor på Trelleborg Sealing Solutions i Helsingör och är specialiserade på utveckling och tillverkning av tätningssystem för högteknologiska företag inom hydraulik-, fordons-, flyg-, marin-, olje- och maskinindustrin. Även om vi kanske inte är särskilt välkända hos allmänheten är vi bland de främsta i världen inom vårt område och uppskattas av våra kunder för våra produkter och vår kvalitet. Det uppnår vi genom att ständigt ställa höga krav på oss själva, våra leverantörer och inte minst våra produkter. Vi är en del av den börsnoterade Trelleborg Group med närmare 17 000 medarbetare världen över.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?
Hos Trelleborg Sealing Solutions blir du en del av ett företag som bidrar till att bilar presterar bättre, flygplan landar säkert och maskiner fungerar även under extrema förhållanden.

Dessutom kan du se fram emot:
.    En arbetsplats med god stämning, stark gemenskap och många erfarna kollegor
.    Erfarenhet från ett globalt företag som är ledande inom sin bransch och känt för sina kvalitetsprodukter
.    Personalförening, idrottsförening, konstförening, sjukvårdsförsäkring, hälsokontroll vid start på nattskift samt en fantastisk personalrestaurang
.    Anställning enligt Industriens Overenskomst

Låter det som något för dig?
Då ser vi fram emot att ta emot din ansökan och ditt CV senast den 30 november via formuläret nedan.
Vi håller intervjuer löpande och tar bort annonsen när vi har hittat rätt kandidater. Vänta därför inte för länge med att söka om du är intresserad.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta:
.    Produktionschef Silas Thirunamakkarasu, telefon +45 31 10 07 57
.    Produktionschef Morten Månsson, telefon +45 31 71 31 85

På Trelleborg Sealing Solutions behandlar vi alla lika. Vi värdesätter mångfald och är stolta över att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö för alla medarbetare. Vi välkomnar ansökningar oavsett kön, ålder, nationalitet, religion, identitet eller bakgrund.

title: Afløser til Kære Pleje Odense
description:
Flere af vores dygtige afløsere skal snart videre på uddannelse , og derfor søger vi nye kolleger, der brænder for at gøre en forskel for borgerne i deres eget hjem.

Vi er en privat leverandør i Odense Kommune og leverer helhedspleje samt praktisk og personlig hjælp efter serviceloven. Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde i et fagligt engageret og fleksibelt team, hvor borgernes trivsel altid er i centrum.

Vi tilbyder fleksible arbejdstider, så du kan tage vagter om aftenen og/eller i weekenderne – perfekt, hvis du ønsker et studiejob eller et fleksibelt bijob.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring fra pleje- og omsorgsområdet, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og gøre en positiv forskel. Vi sørger for en grundig oplæring, så du bliver godt klædt på til opgaverne.

Hos os arbejder vi ud fra værdierne omsorg, respekt, tryghed og fleksibilitet. Det er værdier, der præger vores hverdag og den måde, vi møder både borgere og kolleger på.

Kan du genkende dig selv i disse værdier, og er det sådan, du ønsker at arbejde, så er vi et godt match.

Det er et krav, at du som minimum kan tage 4-5 vagter om måneden.

Er du i gang med en uddannelse som social- og sundhedshjælper (SSH), social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA), pædagogisk assistent (PAU) eller sygeplejerske, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Er du vores ny cafemedarbejder? :)
description:
Er du vores nye selvstændige cafémedarbejder i Kbh NV?

Har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for baren i en hyggelig café, hvor tempoet varierer og humøret næsten altid er højt? Hos Café Sirius i København NV søger vi lige nu en udadvendt og ansvarsfuld kollega, der elsker rollen som vært.

Stillingen er fleksibel og ligger på mellem 15 og 32 timer om ugen (svarende til ca. 3-5 vagter om ugen). Vi hører derfor gerne fra både dig, der søger et solidt studiejob ved siden af uddannelsen, og dig, der ønsker flere faste timer f.eks. i dit sabbatår.

Om jobbet:

Du styrer baren: Du står ofte alene i fronten, hvor du brygger kaffe, skænker drikkevarer, servere mad, vasker op og hygger om gæsterne.

  • Tæt samarbejde: Selvom du er alene i baren, er du aldrig helt alene på vagt – du arbejder tæt sammen med vores kok, som styrer køkkenet og står for al maden.

  • Hverdagen hos os: Dagene kan være meget forskellige. Nogle dage har vi rygende travlt, mens der andre dage kan være helt stille, hvor vi bruger tiden på grundig rengøring, opfyldning og ekstra kræs for stamgæsterne.

Arbejdstid: Vagterne vil være en blanding af hverdage og weekender. Dag og aften.

Hvem er du?

  • Du er udadvendt, smilende og trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar i baren.

  • Du kan holde hovedet koldt, når der er travlt, men har også selvstændigt initiativ til at finde på noget at lave, når der er stille dage.

  • Du er mødestabil, ansvarsfuld og klar på et godt samarbejde med køkkenet.

  • Erfaring som barista eller fra branchen er et plus, men ikke et krav – vi skal nok lære dig op!

Løn og hvad vi tilbyder:

  • Fast timeløn på 125 kr.

  • Masser af ansvar, frihed og plads til at sætte dit eget præg på hverdagen.

  • En jordnær og utrolig hyggelig arbejdsplads i Nordvest med et godt sammenhold.

  • Fleksible arbejdstider, der kan passes ind med din hverdag eller studie.
