title: Maler søges til TB Enterprise ApS
description:
TB Enterprise ApS søger en dygtig og engageret maler til vores team.

Vi søger en erfaren maler, der kan udføre malerarbejde af høj kvalitet og har fokus på godt håndværk, præcision og en professionel arbejdsindsats.

Om jobbet

Som maler hos TB Enterprise ApS vil du udføre forskellige typer malerarbejde på byggepladser og hos kunder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Indvendigt og udvendigt malerarbejde

  • Forberedelse af overflader, herunder slibning, spartling og grunding

  • Maling af vægge, lofter, træværk og andre overflader

  • Opsætning og behandling af forskellige typer overflader

  • Klargøring af materialer og arbejdsområder

  • Reparation og finish af eksisterende malerarbejde

  • Sikring af, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med de aftalte kvalitetskrav

  • Oprydning og vedligeholdelse af arbejdsområdet

Vi forventer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med professionelt malerarbejde

  • Har gode håndværksmæssige færdigheder og sans for detaljer

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Kan samarbejde med kolleger og andre faggrupper

  • Er mødestabil og pålidelig

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og arbejdsmiljø

  • Kan følge instruktioner og planlægge dine arbejdsopgaver effektivt

En relevant faglig uddannelse som maler er en fordel. Tilsvarende praktisk erfaring og kvalifikationer kan også komme i betragtning.

Vi tilbyder

Hos TB Enterprise ApS tilbyder vi:

  • Fuldtidsansættelse

  • Varierede maleropgaver

  • Et professionelt arbejdsmiljø

  • Gode kolleger og et tæt samarbejde

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer

  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til kvalifikationer og gældende regler

Arbejdssted

Arbejdet udføres på virksomhedens projekter og hos kunder forskellige steder i Danmark.

Det må forventes, at arbejdsstedet kan variere afhængigt af de aktuelle projekter.

Arbejdstid

Stillingen er på fuld tid, som udgangspunkt 37 timer om ugen.

Arbejdstiden aftales nærmere i forbindelse med ansættelsen og tilrettelægges efter de aktuelle projekter.

Løn

Lønnen fastsættes efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt i overensstemmelse med gældende danske regler.

Ansøgning

Er du interesseret i stillingen, bedes du sende dit CV og en kort ansøgning med oplysninger om din erfaring og relevante kvalifikationer.

Ansøgningen sendes til TB Enterprise ApS.

Vi indkalder relevante kandidater løbende til en samtale.

Om TB Enterprise ApS

TB Enterprise ApS er en dansk virksomhed, der udfører forskellige bygge- og håndværksrelaterede opgaver. Vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, ansvarlighed og et professionelt samarbejde.

Vi søger medarbejdere, der ønsker at bidrage aktivt til virksomhedens projekter og virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling.

title: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

  • Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

  • Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

  • Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

  • Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

  • Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

  • Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

  • A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

  • The best staff meals, enjoyed in our social spaces overlooking the city. 

  • Exciting (on the job) training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO

  • Bring good vibes to the work floor

  • Are genuinely friendly, approachable, and empathetic.

  • Show strong leadership skills and know how to empower and grow their team.

  • Can juggle many tasks at once while remaining cool-headed and warm-hearted.

  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit and never settle for less than amazing.

  • Have worked in an international workplace.

  • Have provable knowledge of maintaining a high standard of guest service and team engagement.


A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You speak fluent Danish and English.

  • You have a minimum of 3 years working experience leading operational teams in the Front Office and/or Food and Beverage department.

  • You’ve worked with PMS and POS software.

  • You are an EU-resident or have a valid Danish working permit.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days/hours.

  • You love to work as we'll need you full time.

title: Vi søger kokke og køkkenmedhjælpere
description:
Evim Restaurant ApS søger passioneret kok og dygtige køkkenmedhjælpere

Evim Restaurant ApS slår dørene op for en autentisk spiseoplevelse, og vi leder efter det helt rigtige team til vores køkken. Vores koncept er bygget op omkring ægte tyrkisk madkultur med et stærkt fokus på traditionelle retter fra Anatolien. Vi serverer en indbydende orientalsk buffet og specialiserer os i klassisk "sulu yemek" – de varme, hjemmelavede tyrkiske simreretter, der smager fuldstændig, som de gør i Tyrkiet.

Vi søger både en kokke og energiske køkkenmedhjælpere, der brænder for at levere høj kvalitet og autentiske smagsoplevelser til vores gæster.

Tyrkisk Kok til det traditionelle køkken

Som kok hos Evim bliver du omdrejningspunktet for vores menu. Du skal have en dyb forståelse for de tyrkiske og anatolske madtraditioner og sætte en ære i at lave mad fra bunden.

Dine primære opgaver:

Tilberedning af klassiske tyrkiske retter, med særligt fokus på "sulu yemek", meze og anatolske specialiteter.

  • Planlægning, produktion og præsentation af vores store orientalske buffet.

  • Sikre en konsekvent høj kulinarisk standard og den helt rigtige, autentiske smag.

  • Egenkontrol, varehåndtering og sikring af høj hygiejne i køkkenet.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har solid og dokumenteret erfaring med det traditionelle tyrkiske køkken (dette er et krav).

  • Er vant til at arbejde med buffet og kan beregne mængder effektivt.

  • Er struktureret, kvalitetsbevidst og kan bevare roen i travle perioder.

Lærenemme Køkkenmedhjælpere til tyrkisk køkken

Som køkkenmedhjælper er du kokkens uundværlige højre hånd. Du sørger for, at produktionen glider, og at gæsterne altid præsenteres for en frisk og velforsynet buffet. Du skal ønske at udvikle dig inden for det tyrksike køkken.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Forberedelse og klargøring af råvarer (snitte, skære og marinere).

  • Assistere kokken under tilberedningen af varme og kolde retter.

  • Opfyldning og trimning af buffeten under aftenens service.

  • Opvask, oprydning og rengøring, så køkkenet altid står skarpt.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er mødestabil, arbejdsom og trives i et miljø med et højt arbejdstempo.

  • Har erfaring fra et storkøkken eller restaurant, men vigtigst er din indstilling og lyst til at lære.

  • Er en holdspiller, der naturligt tager fra, hvor der mangler hænder.

Vi tilbyder

"Evim" betyder mit hjem, og det er netop den følelse, vi ønsker at skabe for både vores gæster og vores personale. Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med et stærkt fællesskab, gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold, samt løn der modsvarer dine kvalifikationer. Du får stor mulighed for at arbejde med de bedste råvarer og sætte dit præg på restaurantens succes.

Ansøgning

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rigtige profiler. Forventet opstart er i oktober/november efter aftale.

title: Bartendere søges til nyt projekt
description:

Tamashii betyder “sjæl” på japansk, og køkkenet bliver moderne asiatisk med Henrik Jyrks personlige aftryk. Ambitionen er høj, med teknik og råvarekvalitet i den skarpe ende, men uden den formalitet, der ofte forbindes med fine dining.

Du laver cocktails, serverer vin og drikkevarer og er samtidig med til at skabe den stemning, som gør baren til et sted, gæsterne har lyst til at blive hængende.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring som bartender – gerne fra en travl og ambitiøs bar eller restaurant.

  • Har solid forståelse for cocktails, spiritus og/eller vin.

  • Trives i et højt tempo og bevarer overblikket i service.

  • Er udadvendt, imødekommende og god til at skabe kontakt til gæster.

title: Fine dining restaurant Tamashii søger tjenere
description:
I November åbner Norrlyst Koncernen dørene til Tamashii - et nyt ambitiøst restaurantprojekt på en af Københavns mest unikke lokationer

Tamashii betyder “sjæl” på japansk, og køkkenet bliver moderne asiatisk med Henrik Jyrks personlige aftryk. Ambitionen er høj, med teknik og råvarekvalitet i den skarpe ende, men uden den formalitet, der ofte forbindes med fine dining.

Fra køkken og service til vinkort og indretning er Tamashii skabt med en ambition om at nå Michelin-niveau.

Norrlyst Koncernen står bag nogle af Københavns mest markante restauranter og vinbarer. Fælles for vores steder er en kompromisløs tilgang til kvalitet, stærkt værtskab og et ønske om at skabe oplevelser, der huskes.

Vi tror på, at stærk service starter med stærke mennesker. Derfor skaber vi rammer, hvor engagement, personlighed og samarbejde er i centrum – og hvor man som medarbejder bliver en vigtig del af helheden fra dag ét.

Som tjener bliver du ansigtet udadtil og en afgørende del af den samlede oplevelse.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger i service og køkken og er med til at sikre, at gæsterne får en oplevelse, der føles nærværende, professionel og gennemtænkt – fra første velkomst til sidste farvel.

Du trives på gulvet, har energi i service og elsker at få mennesker til at føle sig godt tilpas.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring som tjener.

  • Er imødekommende, smilende og naturligt serviceminded.

  • Trives i et travlt miljø og bevarer overblikket, når tempoet er højt.

  • Er en holdspiller, der bidrager til god energi og et stærkt fællesskab.

  • Har interesse for mad, vin og den gode gæsteoplevelse.

  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig og blive dygtigere i et professionelt restaurantmiljø.

Vi tilbyder

  • En unik mulighed for at være med til åbningen af en ny og ambitiøs restaurant.

  • En hverdag tæt på gæsterne i et stærkt og professionelt team.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling inden for service, værtskab og vin.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med højt tempo, god stemning og stærkt sammenhold.

  • Attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

  • Personalefordele på tværs af Norrlyst Koncernens restauranter og vinbarer.

Hvis du har lyst til at skabe gode oplevelser, være en del af et stærkt team og arbejde et sted med høje ambitioner, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Som restaurantchef bliver du en nøgleperson i åbningen og får ansvaret for at skabe rammerne for en serviceoplevelse, der er lige så gennemtænkt som gastronomien.

Du skal sikre, at gæsteoplevelsen hænger sammen fra første kontakt til sidste farvel – og at teamet arbejder som én enhed, hvor struktur, overblik og energi går hånd i hånd.

Du er tæt på driften, men også på kulturen. Du er synlig på gulvet, sætter retning for dit team og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor faglighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Vi forestiller os, at du

title: engageret sælger til Lilly på Frederiksberg
description:

title: Rengøringsmedarbejdere søges til fuldtidsstillinger
description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder søger vi stabile og ansvarsbevidste rengøringsmedarbejdere til faste fuldtidsstillinger.

Du kommer til at arbejde med rengøring hos private kunder på forskellige adresser i hovedstadsområdet, Nordsjælland og ned mod Roskilde.

Der stilles firmabil til rådighed, som du kan køre hjem i og benytte direkte ud til dagens kunder. Du skal derfor som udgangspunkt ikke møde ind på virksomhedens adresse i Nivå hver dag.

Du vil kun skulle forbi adressen i Nivå en gang imellem, eksempelvis for at hente rene klude, rengøringsprodukter og øvrigt udstyr.

Dagens rute planlægges så vidt muligt med udgangspunkt i din bopæl.

Arbejdsopgaver

Arbejdet består af almindelig rengøring i private hjem, herunder:

  • Støvsugning og gulvvask

  • Afstøvning

  • Rengøring og afkalkning af køkken og badeværelse

  • Fjernelse af spindelvæv

  • Øvrige almindelige rengøringsopgaver

Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav, da du får den nødvendige oplæring.

Arbejdstid

Du skal kunne stå til rådighed mandag til fredag mellem kl. 08.00 og 16.00.

Du er garanteret minimum 32 timer om ugen, og der vil typisk være mulighed for flere timer. Stillingen betragtes derfor som fuldtid.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort – dette er et krav

  • Er stabil og møder til tiden

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver

  • Er serviceminded og respektfuld, da arbejdet foregår i private hjem

  • Har sans for kvalitet og grundighed

  • Gerne har erfaring med rengøring, men det er ikke et krav

Praktisk information

Område: Hovedstadsområdet, Nordsjælland og ned mod Roskilde

Arbejdstid: Mandag–fredag mellem kl. 08.00–16.00

Timer: Minimum 32 timer om ugen, typisk flere

Firmabil: Ja – bilen kan køres med hjem og bruges direkte ud til kunderne

Mødested: Du skal ikke møde i Nivå hver dag. Der vil kun være behov for at komme forbi virksomheden lejlighedsvis for at hente klude, produkter og andet udstyr.

Ansættelse: Timelønnet hos vores kunde

Opstart: Efter nærmere aftale

Du får adgang til virksomhedens system, hvor du kan se dagens kunder, adresser og tider samt registrere start og afslutning på opgaverne.

Ansøgning

Er du interesseret i stillingen, så send os dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af dig selv.

title: Konsulent til Indkøb Himmerland
description:
Har du indgående kendskab til indkøbs- og udbudsområdet i en kommunal kontekst, og trives du i en stilling tæt på ledelsen, hvor du bidrager til det strategiske arbejde? Er du god til at skabe overblik, og kan du sikre fremgang i processer? Så er det måske dig vi søger til en konsulentstilling i en nyopstartet fælles udbuds- og indkøbsenhed i Hobro. 

 

Om Indkøb Himmerland 

Indkøb Himmerland er en fælles udbuds- og indkøbsenhed for Mariagerfjord, Rebild og Vesthimmerlands Kommune. Enheden er etableret 1. januar 2026 for at samle indkøbskompetencerne, sikre en fælles strategisk retning og styrke kvaliteten og effektiviteten i indkøb og udbud på tværs af kommunerne. 

Indkøb Himmerland er samtidig et fagligt miljø med ambitioner om at udvikle udbudspraksis og styrke den strategiske anvendelse af indkøb. 

 

Stillingen 

Vi søger en kollega med indgående kendskab til indkøbs- og udbudsfunktionen, som kan understøtte ledelse og bestyrelse i Indkøb Himmerland og bidrage til opgaveløsningen på tværs af de to teams i organisationen. Din tætteste samarbejdspartner bliver lederen i Indkøb Himmerland, som du, sammen med bestyrelsen, kommer til at understøtte i det daglige og strategiske arbejde. Du bliver en del af en ambitiøs indkøbs- og udbudsenhed, hvor du gør en forskel for både borgere og kolleger på tværs af de tre kommuner. 

2026 er et etableringsår, og der pågår aktuelt en del strategisk arbejde i bestyrelsen, som du kommer til at understøtte. Her er det vigtigt, at din faglige forståelse for indkøbs- og udbudsfunktionen, samt dinerfaring og forståelse for den ledet politiske organisation kommer tydeligt til udtryk.   

I Indkøb Himmerland er vi 13 medarbejdere fordelt på Team Udbud og Team Kontrakt. Du bliver ansat i en konsulentstilling, hvor du får en central rolle i at understøtte ledelsen og samtidig bidrager til opgaveløsningen på tværs af de to teams. Vi prioriterer et godt samarbejde og et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med rig mulighed for sparring.  

 

Hvem er du? 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har et solidt kendskab til indkøbs- og udbudsområdet og de dynamikker, der gør sig gældende her 

  • Kan navigere i de politiske landskaber i de tre samarbejdskommuner og de forskellige hensyn, der er her 

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og koordineringsevner og bidrager til det gode samarbejde både internt i Indkøb Himmerland, men også på tværs i de tre samarbejdskommuner 

  • Har erfaring med arbejdet i en politisk styret organisation 

  • Har erfaring med betjening af ledelser og evt. bestyrelser i en kommune  

  • Trives i krydsfeltet mellem medarbejdere og ledelse  

 

Hvad tilbyder vi? 

  • En spændende og fagligt udfordrende stilling i en fælles indkøbs- og udbudsenhed med 13 kolleger 

  • Videre udvikling af dine kompetencer på indkøbs- og udbudsområdet 

  • En stilling tæt på ledelsen, hvor du har mulighed for at påvirke det strategiske arbejde 

  • God indføring i opgaverne og rig mulighed for løbende sparring og feedback 

  • Stor fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar. For os er hjemmearbejde en naturlig del af hverdagen, hvad enten du har brug for en uforstyrret fordybelsesdag til de komplekse sager, eller familielivets logistik skal gå op.  

 

Arbejdssted 

Din daglige arbejdsplads bliver i Hobro, hvor Indkøb Himmerland har base. Her samles udbuds- og indkøbskompetencerne fra de tre kommuner i et fælles fagligt miljø, som arbejder med både daglig opgaveløsning og videreudvikling af fælles arbejdsgange og processer. 

Vi prioriterer en god balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv. Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt og er omfattet af flextidsordning. Der er mulighed for op til to hjemmearbejdsdage om ugen efter nærmere aftale og under hensyn til opgaver, samarbejde og fælles tilstedeværelse. 

Ansøgning 

Send din ansøgning og CV via Jobnet senest den 09. oktober 2026.

title: Vært søges til Airport Hotel Billund
description:
Er du bedst, når andre er på vej hjem?

Bliv Host på Airport Hotel Billund og kom med på vores vækstrejse

Er du typen, der får mere energi, når dagen bliver til aften? Trives du med mennesker, tempo og god stemning og vil du være med til at skabe noget nyt?

Så skal du måske med på den rejse, vi er på lige nu.

Airport Hotel Billund er under stor forandring. Vi bygger om, udvikler og skaber en ny og endnu stærkere version af hotellet. Med ny stor bar og restaurant, vinbar og nye rammer for vores gæster bliver hotellet i endnu højere grad et sted, hvor mennesker mødes, spiser, drikker, arbejder og lander efter en lang dag. Og til det har vi brug for flere dygtige mennesker.

Vi søger en Host til vores aftenteam

Hos os er du ikke bare receptionist.

Du er Host og en vigtig del af hele gæsteoplevelsen.

Du tager imod gæsten, skaber relationen og sørger for, at tingene spiller. Det ene øjeblik hjælper du en international forretningsrejsende med check-in, det næste hjælper du i baren, besvarer spørgsmål eller sørger for, at en familie får en god start på ferien.

Vi arbejder på tværs, hjælper hinanden og har fokus på den samlede gæsteoplevelse frem for klassiske kasser og afdelingsgrænser.

Og ja – du skal være et aftenmenneske

Stillingen er primært til dig, der gerne vil arbejde, når andre holder fri.

Dine vagter vil typisk ligge fra omkring kl. 15.00 til midnat eller kl. 18.00 til ca. kl. 02.00.

Så hvis du helst vil møde ind senere på dagen, trives med energien om aftenen og ikke har noget imod, at arbejdsdagen slutter efter midnat, kan det her være et rigtig godt match.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder ikke nødvendigvis efter det perfekte CV. Vi leder efter den rigtige personlighed.

Du er serviceminded, nysgerrig og har lyst til mennesker. Du tager ansvar, ser hvad der skal gøres og giver gerne en kollega en hånd, når der er brug for det.

Du kan bevare overblikket, når der er fart på, og du forstår, at godt værtskab både ligger i de store oplevelser og de små detaljer.

Erfaring fra hotel, restaurant, bar, café, retail eller anden service er selvfølgelig en fordel, men din energi, indstilling og lyst til at lære betyder mindst lige så meget for os.

Hvorfor lige nu?

Fordi det faktisk er et ret spændende tidspunkt at blive en del af Airport Hotel Billund.

Du kommer ikke ind i et hotel, hvor alt skal fortsætte præcis, som det altid har gjort.

Du kommer ind midt i en udviklings- og vækstrejse, hvor hotellet fysisk forandrer sig, nye koncepter kommer til, og vi sammen skal skabe den næste version af Airport Hotel Billund.

Derfor er der også plads til mennesker med idéer, ambitioner og lyst til at udvikle sig.

Har du lyst til at være med fra starten?

Så ansøg via linket senest den 31.oktober 2026

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores Host Manager på paulina@billundhotel.dk. Marker emnelinjen ”Vært søges til Airport Hotel”

Vi er den del af Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels har flere unikke hoteller i Danmark. Hotelporteføljen byder urbane city hoteller og ikoniske boutiquehoteller. Selvom alle hotellerne er forskellige og har hver deres unikke særpræg, leverer alle medarbejdere værtskab ud fra de samme værdier:  omhu, fleksibilitet, nærvær, passion og respekt for mennesker og miljø.

title: Pædagog eller medhjælper søges til MammenFri
description:
Kan du bygge en hule på 3 minutter, finde en regnorm med lukkede øjne og skabe tryghed midt i kaos?

Så er det måske DIG, vi leder efter! Hos MammenFri mangler vi en fantastisk pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller medhjælper, til vores børnehus fra den 1. november 2026 (eller så hurtigt du kan finde dine gummistøvler). Stillingen er på mellem 30 og 37 timer.

Hvem er vi? MammenFri er ikke bare en institution – vi er et fællesskab fyldt med grin, leg, læring, nysgerrighed og mennesker, der brænder for det, de laver. Vi består af 18 vuggestuebørn, 31 børnehavebørn, 86 skoleelever og så en flok engagerede voksne, som hver dag gør deres bedste for at skabe gode børneliv. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med friskolen, fordi vi tror på, at stærke relationer og fællesskaber skaber de bedste rammer for børn.

Vi elsker at være ude. Faktisk så meget, at vi er blevet en del af De Grønne Spirer. Her bliver mudder, pinde, regnvejr og naturens små mirakler ofte en del af dagens program. Samtidig er vi på en spændende rejse med Reggio Emilia-pædagogikken, hvor nysgerrighed, kreativitet og børnenes perspektiver er i centrum.

Og vigtigst af alt? Hos os er der højt til loftet, plads til skæve idéer og kort afstand fra: "Det kunne være sjovt..." til: "Det gør vi!"

Hvem er du?

Måske kan du nikke genkendende til noget af dette:

Du brænder for arbejdet med børn fra 0-6 år, da vi arbejder aldersintegreret

Du ser muligheder, hvor andre ser udfordringer

Du er faglig og reflekteret i dit arbejde

Du er nærværende, autentisk og kan skabe stærke relationer

Du tager ansvar og følger tingene til dørs

Du kan både lege pirat, naturvejleder, konfliktmægler og trøstemester – nogle gange inden klokken 10

Du er nysgerrig på Reggio Emilia eller har erfaring med det

Du har lyst til at være en del af hele huset og samarbejde på tværs af vuggestue, børnehave og SFO

Hvad får du hos os?

Kollegaer med høj faglighed, godt humør og lyst til samarbejde

En arbejdsplads hvor fællesskab er noget, vi gør

Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på udviklingen

Et hus fyldt med energi, engagement og masser af grin

Forældre og bestyrelse, der bakker op og engagerer sig

En arbejdsplads i bevægelse, hvor vi hele tiden er nysgerrige på, hvordan vi kan gøre det endnu bedre

Hvis du drømmer om en arbejdsplads med plads til både faglighed, fællesskab, natur, udvikling og masser af børnelatter, så håber vi, at du sender en ansøgning. Måske, er du den næste, der skal være med til at gøre MammenFri til verdens bedste sted at være barn.

title: Produktionsmedarbejdere, kranfører og finishmedarbejder søges til betonproduktion
description:
Vi søger 10 medarbejdere til en større produktionsvirksomhed inden for betonelementer i Kolind.

Har du erfaring fra produktion, byggeri, beton eller andet praktisk arbejde – og trives du med fysisk arbejde, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er vigtigt? Så kan det være dig, vi søger.

Der er tale om Try & Hire med henblik på fastansættelse hos virksomheden efter endt periode.

Vi søger 8 produktionsmedarbejdere

Du bliver en del af produktionen af betonelementer og kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med:

  • Armering

  • Klargøring til støbning

  • Opbygning af træforskalling og støbeforme

  • Afformning og håndtering af betonelementer

  • Andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra beton-, bygge- eller produktionsbranchen, men det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt og klar på at lære.

1 kranfører

Du kommer primært til at arbejde med intern transport og håndtering af større betonelementer – blandt andet udendørs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har gyldigt krancertifikat m. tilladelse til 52 ton.

  • Har erfaring med krankørsel, gerne fra industri eller produktion

  • Arbejder sikkert og ansvarsbevidst

  • Er indstillet på udendørs arbejde året rundt

1 medarbejder til finish

Her bliver din primære opgave at sikre den sidste finish på betonelementerne, efter de er taget ud af formene.

Opgaverne består bl.a. af:

  • Mindre reparationer af betonelementer

  • Udbedring af kanter, hjørner og mindre skader efter afformning

  • Finish og kvalitetssikring

  • Andre praktiske håndværksmæssige opgaver

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være uddannet håndværker, men du skal gerne have hænderne skruet godt på og sans for kvalitet og finish.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er mødestabil og klar til en fysisk arbejdsdag

  • Trives i et produktionsmiljø

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et team

  • Har en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Selv kan transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen

Arbejdstider

Arbejdstiden ligger som udgangspunkt:

Mandag–torsdag: kl. 06.00–14.10
Fredag: kl. 06.00–13.40

Der kan alternativt være mulighed for mødetid kl. 07.00.

Vi tilbyder

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

  • Fuldtidsarbejde

  • Løn efter gældende overenskomst

  • Ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • En arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for at lære og udvikle sig

  • Try & Hire-forløb med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

Skriv gerne i din ansøgning, om du søger produktion, truck eller finish.

title: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

  • Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

  • Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

  • Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

  • Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

  • Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

  • Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

  • A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

  • The best staff meals, enjoyed in our social spaces overlooking the city. 

  • Exciting (on the job) training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO

  • Bring good vibes to the work floor

  • Are genuinely friendly, approachable, and empathetic.

  • Show strong leadership skills and know how to empower and grow their team.

  • Can juggle many tasks at once while remaining cool-headed and warm-hearted.

  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit and never settle for less than amazing.

  • Have worked in an international workplace.

  • Have provable knowledge of maintaining a high standard of guest service and team engagement.


A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You speak fluent Danish and English.

  • You have a minimum of 3 years working experience leading operational teams in the Front Office and/or Food and Beverage department.

  • You’ve worked with PMS and POS software.

  • You are an EU-resident or have a valid Danish working permit.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days/hours.

  • You love to work as we'll need you full time.

title: KS3 and IGCSE English Teacher (Year 7 – Year 11)
description:
International School Ikast-Brande (ISIB) is looking for a qualified Cambridge English teacher with experience teaching English to students from Year 7 – Year 11. Preference will be given to candidates who have experience teaching IGCSE First Language English and are native speakers. Interviews will be arranged immediately as the Leadership Team would like to recruit as soon as possible.  

This is a full-time, permanent & pensionable position starting as soon as possible. As an inclusive school, we encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We value the richness that diverse perspectives and lived experiences bring to our community, and we are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where every individual feels respected and supported.  

 

The School: 

International School Ikast-Brande is located in the heart of Denmark and has approximately 200 students across Early Years, Primary and Secondary sections, with one class per year group. Our students are highly motivated and speak very positively about the school. We are committed to providing high-quality international education to families relocating to Denmark, as well as to local families seeking a rigorous international curriculum for their children.  

Our student body is wonderfully diverse, representing a wide range of nationalities and cultural backgrounds. We encourage our students to balance academic achievement with a well-rounded, healthy lifestyle. From an early age, we instil in them a strong sense of right and wrong, empowering them to make thoughtful and responsible decisions. As a result, we enjoy a positive school climate with very few behavioural issues.  

Our teaching team is as vibrant and international as our student body. You will often hear laughter coming from our staffroom and in the corridors. Our team meets regularly to collaborate on educational and operational matters, fostering a collegial and supportive environment.  

 

Requirements: 

In line with the school’s overarching policies and procedures, the successful candidate will be expected to: 

  • Plan and develop engaging & high-quality lessons, tailored to our learners’ needs; 

  • Maintain a student-focused, positive approach to teaching and learning; 

  • Deliver dynamic, stimulating and culturally engaging lessons;  

  • Promote student wellbeing through an understanding of each child’s individuality;  

  • Assess and report on students’ progress effectively;  

  • Manage student behaviour in a positive and constructive manner;  

  • Participate actively in whole-school activities and events;  

  • Employ a solutions-focused mindset;  

  • Maintain a great sense of humour and contribute to a positive work environment;  

  • Be internationally minded and a collaborative team player. 

 

What We Can Offer: 

  • A competitive salary and excellent pension scheme, in line with collective agreements; 

  • A genuine and sustainable work-life balance; 

  • State-of-the-art, modern teaching and learning facilities; 

  • Small class sizes with engaged, capable and curious students; 

  • A calm and respectful learning environment, with motivated and well-disciplined pupils; 

  • A flexible working culture, built on mutual trust and professional autonomy; 

  • A supportive and visible Senior Leadership Team, deeply committed to staff and community wellbeing; 

  • A leadership approach that values collaboration, open dialogue and teacher voice - ensuring staff feel heard, empowered and appreciated; 

  • A culturally diverse, inclusive and welcoming team of professionals; 

  • Strong, constructive partnerships with engaged and supportive parents; 

  • Ongoing professional learning, development opportunities and team-building events. 

 

What Denmark Can Offer: 

Living and working in Denmark offers a unique opportunity to enjoy one of the world’s highest standards of living. Teachers benefit from: 

  • An excellent work-life balance supported by a strong social welfare system; 

  • A safe, clean and well-organised society with low levels of crime; 

  • High-quality, publicly funded healthcare and childcare services; 

  • A focus on family life, personal wellbeing and professional respect; 

  • Beautiful natural surroundings; 

  • Easy access to travel across Denmark, Europe and further afield; 

  • An international community that welcomes newcomers and supports integration; 

  • A strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. 

 

Salary: 

Salary and pension are determined in accordance with the collective agreement and union contract established between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Teachers’ Central Organisation. 

Please note that both local and international teachers are employed under the same pay scales and working conditions. 

While the school does not offer formal relocation packages, we are committed to supporting new staff and work closely with individuals to find practical and helpful solutions throughout their transition. To further assist international staff with their move, initial relocation support is provided during the first year of employment. 

 

Application: 

If you are a skilled, adaptable and solutions-oriented educator, we warmly invite you to apply by sending your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience to job@isib.dk. Letters of recommendation are also welcomed. All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory police security checks.   

The Senior Leadership Team intends to appoint as soon as a suitable candidate is identified to ensure a smooth transition to our school; therefore, interviews will take place on a rolling basis, and the school reserves the right to make an appointment before the advertised closing date.

title: Postdoc in Behaviour Change interventions (Part-Time, Fixed-Term)
description:
The Danish Centre for Motivation and Behaviour Science (DRIVEN), Research
Unit for Behaviour Science, Motivation and Health (STRIVE) at the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics (IOB), invites applications for a fixed-term, part-time (80%) postdoc position commencing as soon as possible and ending 30 September 2028.

The position is established in connection with the joint project “mPADapp - Digital Decision Support for Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD)” between DRIVEN (SDU), the Institute of Clinical Medicine (IMK) at Aarhus University and the Vascular Research Unit at Viborg Regional Hospital.

About the project

Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) is a major vascular health issue affecting quality of life, mobility, and survival. The mPADapp project aims to improve adherence to clinical guidelines for PAD treatment via an interactive decision support tool. The tool will be integrated into a mobile app for patients and into healthcare providers’ systems, to enhance understanding, motivation, and behaviour change around preventive treatments (e.g. medication adherence, smoking cessation, physical activity etc.). A key component is the development of the app’s behavioural intervention design, grounded in evidence on mechanisms of successful behaviour change.

About the job

The postdoc is expected to manage the design and refinement of an app for telerehabilitation. The role will focus on identifying and integrating effective behaviour change techniques (BCTs), user experience/user-centered design, digital engagement, and mechanisms of motivation, self-regulation, habit formation, and sustained adherence.

Key responsibilities

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary team (clinicians, epidemiologists, app developers, AI-scientists, patient representatives) to co-design the app features that promote sustained behaviour change

  • Review and apply theoretical frameworks and empirical evidence on behaviour change mechanisms (motivation, self-efficacy, intention formation, cues/triggers, habit formation, feedback loops, rewards etc.)

  • Identify BCTs appropriate for PAD patients, particularly those who may have low health literacy, low motivation, sociocultural or economic vulnerabilities

  • Collect and analyse qualitative and quantitative studies (usability testing, field pilots, interviews, survey, digital usage data) to test usability, acceptability, engagement, and mechanisms

  • Contribute to app iteration, interface design, content generation (e.g. messaging, reminders, motivational feedback) ensuring alignment with evidence-based BCTs and self-determination theory

  • Prepare high-quality publications, present at conferences and ensure that findings inform clinical integration and implementation

For information on postdoc positions at the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics in general, please click.

Qualifications

  • A completed PhD or equivalent research experience at PhD level in psychology, behaviour science, public health, digital health, or related field, with demonstrated experience in behaviour change/intervention science

  • Strong knowledge of behaviour change theories and frameworks (e.g. Self-Determination Theory, COM-B, Behaviour Change Wheel, Health Action Process Approach etc.)

  • Experience with digital health interventions or mobile app behaviour support (design and evaluation)

  • Strong collaboration skills, able to work in interdisciplinary teams including clinicians, software developers, and health economists

  • Excellent communication skills in both Danish and English (written and oral)

We offer

  • A stimulating interdisciplinary research environment, with strong ties to vascular surgery, epidemiology, digital health, and user involvement

  • Resources for user panels/patient involvement, usability labs, and collaboration with app developers

  • Opportunities for publication, networking, and professional development

Further information and contact:

For more information about the position and the department, please contact Professor Nikos Ntoumanis, Head of Centre, Tel: (+45) 6550 4525, e-mail: nntoumanis@health.sdu.dk or Jens Troelsen, Head of Department, Tel: (+45) 6550 3493, e-mail: jtroelsen@health.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for the period mentioned above. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years in total at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

The shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Employment as a postdoctoral researcher requires a PhD degree or academic qualifications at PhD level.  

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree or equivalent aacademic qualifications at PhD level (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to 4 of the most relevant publications. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication 

  • Reference letters/references may also be included 

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is 25 October 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics

The Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics adheres to SDU's strategy and values.  Our department is recognized for our interdisciplinary research. The scientific, technical and administrative staff support this through active participation in the department's professional and social life. We prefer candidates with the ambition to make mutual working relationships thrive.

About The Faculty of Health Sciences

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

About Us

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Passenger car auto mechanic
description:
Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled auto mechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,600 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

We imagine that you:

Your new workplace

We offer

title: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

  • Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

  • Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

  • Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

  • Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

  • Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

  • Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

  • Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

  • Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

  • Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

  • Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

  • Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

  • Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

  • UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

  • Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

  • Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

  • Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

  • Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

  • A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

  • Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

  • Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

  • Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

  • Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

  • Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

  • Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

  • EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

  • EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

  • Danish language skills

Your competencies

  • Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

  • Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

  • Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

  • Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

  • Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

  • Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com)

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg

English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

title: SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN? - ARE YOU READY TO JOIN THE JOURNEY?
description:
SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN?

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent med ambitioner

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som både er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig.

Måske har du mange års erfaring med rengøring. Måske har du arbejdet i private hjem, hos erhvervskunder, med kvalitetssikring eller koordinering. Eller måske ved du bare, at du kan mere, end du får mulighed for at vise i dit nuværende job.

Så kan RenTid være stedet for dig.

⚠️ EN VIGTIG TING, DU SKAL VIDE

Hos RenTid starter alle på gulvet.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent – ikke som leder, supervisor eller direktør.

Du starter sammen med alle andre, ude hos kunderne og med rengøringen i hænderne.

Vi er ikke så optagede af din titel eller hvad der står på dit CV. Vi vil se:

  • Hvad du kan

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Din indstilling og arbejdsmoral

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder og kollegaer

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har det, der skal til for at vokse med RenTid

HVOR KAN DET FØRE DIG HEN?

Det ved vi ikke på forhånd. Det afhænger af dig.

Når RenTid vokser, opstår nye muligheder. Den rigtige medarbejder kan derfor med tiden få mere ansvar, eksempelvis:

  • Ansvar for bestemte kunder

  • Kvalitetskontrol

  • Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

  • Koordinering af kollegaer

  • Planlægning af opgaver

  • Kundekontakt

  • Ansvar for bestemte områder

  • Teamlederfunktioner

  • Driftsansvar

  • På længere sigt endnu større ansvar i virksomheden

Mulighederne er mange, hvis du viser, at du er klar til dem.

Vi vil gerne finde en person, som på sigt kan blive en central del af RenTid. Men større ansvar, højere løn og flere goder følger med det, du viser, du kan løfte.

DU STARTER MED EN GOD LØN

Vi tilbyder en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Men vi er også ærlige: Du starter ikke på en direktørløn.

Som rengøringsassistent får du ikke automatisk lederansvar, højere løntrin, fri firmabil, fri telefon eller andre goder, der følger med større ansvar.

Det arbejder man sig frem til.

Når du tager ansvar, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte en større rolle, følger mulighederne med.

DINE OPGAVER

Du skal først og fremmest kunne det vigtigste:

Rengøring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn, både private hjem og erhvervskunder.

Du skal kunne arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt og forstå, at vores kunder forventer et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Hos RenTid skal rengøring ikke bare overstås.

Det skal gøres ordentligt.

Du skal have øje for detaljerne, tage ansvar og sætte en ære i at levere et resultat, der lever op til RenTids standarder.

HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG?

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Men vi forventer, at du vil blive bedre.

Du skal:

  • Være mødestabil og fleksibel

  • Have en positiv attitude

  • Have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Kunne arbejde selvstændigt og i team

  • Have øje for detaljer

  • Sætte en ære i et perfekt resultat

  • Tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kunne modtage og bruge feedback konstruktivt

  • Være loyal over for kunder, kollegaer og RenTid

  • Være løsningsorienteret

  • Kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

  • Have kørekort kategori B

  • Selv kunne komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus

  • Være indforstået med, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde

  • Tale, forstå, læse, og skrive Engelsk

Har du ikke kørekort B, eller ønsker du ikke at køre bil, er stillingen ikke den rette for dig.

⭐ ERFARING ER VIGTIGT

Vi søger en person med stor erfaring inden for rengøring i private hjem. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er det ikke dig, vi søger.

Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring er en klar fordel.

Du skal kende de grundlæggende principper inden for professionel rengøring og kunne arbejde effektivt uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Hos RenTid skærer vi ikke hjørnerne. Vi gør tingene ordentligt.

Men erfaring alene er ikke nok.

Vi leder også efter:

Mindset. Arbejdsmoral. Ansvar. Vilje. Drive.

Du skal have lyst til at blive bedre – og lyst til at blive mere.

⏱️ DE FØRSTE 3 MÅNEDER

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode i henhold til gældende danske regler.

Det er en periode, hvor både du og vi finder ud af, om vi er det rigtige match.

Vi ser blandt andet på:

  • Hvordan du møder på arbejde

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder

  • Hvordan du fungerer med kollegaer

  • Hvordan du reagerer på feedback

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har lyst til at lære

  • Om du har det drive, vi leder efter

Hvis svaret er ja, kan de første tre måneder blive begyndelsen på noget langt større.

HOS RеNTID KAN DU UDVIKLE DIG

Vi tror på, at mennesker kan udvikle sig.

Derfor vil vi hellere finde den rigtige person med det rigtige mindset end den flotteste titel på CV'et.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan blive leder.

Vis os det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan tage ansvar.

Tag det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du har ambitioner.

Vis dem.

HVIS DU VIL MERE...

Vi kan ikke love dig en lederstilling om seks måneder, en firmabil om et år eller en direktørløn.

Det skal du gøre dig fortjent til.

Men vi kan love dig dette:

Hvis du arbejder hårdt, tager ansvar, udvikler dig, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte mere, så vil vi gerne give dig mulighederne for at vokse.

For når RenTid vokser, skal vores medarbejdere have mulighed for at vokse med.

Her starter alle på gulvet. Hvor langt du kan komme derfra, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Stillingen er primært i Aarhus og omegn.

Du skal kunne transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen og være indstillet på, at arbejdsdagen kan foregå hos forskellige kunder.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en ansøgning og dit CV med billede, hvor du fortæller:

  • Hvem du er

  • Hvor længe du har arbejdet med rengøring

  • Din erfaring med private hjem

  • Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

  • Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

  • Hvorfor du passer godt ind hos RenTid

Skriv gerne din ansøgning på Engelsk Mærk ansøgningen "The Journey".

"Jeg skal med på rejsen"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

JOIN US ON THE JOURNEY!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaner with ambition

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaner who is highly skilled at their profession and wants to develop further.

Perhaps you have many years of experience in cleaning, private homes, commercial cleaning, quality control or coordination. Or perhaps you simply know that you have more to offer than you currently get the opportunity to show.

Then RenTid might be the right place for you.

⚠️ ONE IMPORTANT THING YOU NEED TO KNOW

At RenTid, everyone starts on the floor.

You will be hired as a cleaner – not as a manager, supervisor or director.

You start alongside everyone else, working directly with our customers and the cleaning itself.

We are less interested in titles and more interested in seeing:

  • What you can do

  • How you work

  • Your attitude and work ethic

  • How you treat customers and colleagues

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you have what it takes to grow with RenTid

WHERE CAN THIS JOURNEY TAKE YOU?

We don't know in advance.

That depends on you.

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right person can gradually take on more responsibility, such as:

  • Responsibility for specific customers

  • Quality control

  • Training new employees

  • Coordinating colleagues

  • Planning tasks

  • Customer communication

  • Responsibility for specific areas

  • Team leader responsibilities

  • Operational responsibility

  • Greater responsibility within the company over time

There are many opportunities if you show that you are ready for them.

Greater responsibility, higher salary and additional benefits come with what you demonstrate that you can handle.

YOU START WITH A GOOD SALARY

We offer a good and fair salary from day one.

But we are also honest: You will not start on a director's salary.

Management responsibility, higher salary levels, private use of a company car, company phone and other benefits are not automatic.

They are things you work your way towards.

As you take responsibility and deliver results, the opportunities will follow.

YOUR INITIAL ROLE

First and foremost, you need to be able to do the most important thing:

Clean.

You will work at customer locations in Aarhus and the surrounding areas, including private homes and commercial clients.

You must be able to work professionally and independently and understand that our customers expect a result they can be proud of.

At RenTid, cleaning is not something to rush through.

It has to be done properly.

You should have an eye for detail, take responsibility and take pride in meeting RenTid's standards.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

We don't expect you to be perfect. But we expect you to want to become better.

You must:

  • Be reliable and flexible

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Be willing to learn and develop

  • Work independently and as part of a team

  • Have an eye for detail

  • Take pride in delivering a perfect result

  • Take responsibility for your work

  • Receive and use feedback constructively

  • Be loyal to customers, colleagues and RenTid

  • Be solution-oriented

  • Maintain an overview in a busy environment

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Be able to get to and from work in Aarhus independently

  • Be comfortable with possible weekend work

  • Speak, understand, read, and write English

If you do not have a Category B licence or do not want to drive, this position is not for you.

⭐ EXPERIENCE MATTERS

We are looking for someone with extensive experience cleaning private homes. If you do not have this experience, this position is not for you.

Experience with commercial cleaning is a clear advantage.

You should already understand professional cleaning principles and be able to work efficiently without compromising quality.

At RenTid, we don't cut corners. We do things properly.

Experience alone is not enough.

We are also looking for:

Mindset. Work ethic. Responsibility. Determination. Drive.

You must want to become better – and want to become more.

⏱️ THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

The first 3 months are a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish employment law.

This is a period where both you and RenTid can determine whether we are the right match.

We will look at:

  • How you show up for work

  • How you work

  • How you treat customers

  • How you work with colleagues

  • How you respond to feedback

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you want to learn

  • Whether you have the drive we are looking for

If the answer is yes, these first three months could be the beginning of something much bigger.

AT RENTID, YOU CAN DEVELOP

We believe people can develop.

That is why we would rather find the right person with the right mindset than the person with the most impressive title on their CV.

You don't need to tell us you can become a manager.

Show us.

You don't need to tell us you can take responsibility.

Take it.

You don't need to tell us you have ambition.

Show us.

IF YOU WANT MORE...

We cannot promise you a management position in six months, a company car in a year or a director's salary.

You have to earn it.

But we can promise you this:

If you work hard, take responsibility, develop yourself, deliver results and show that you can handle more, we want to give you opportunities to grow.

Because when RenTid grows, our employees should have the opportunity to grow with it.

Everyone starts on the floor. How far you go from there will largely depend on you.

WORKING AREA

The position is primarily based in Aarhus and the surrounding areas.

You must be able to travel to and from work and be comfortable working at different customer locations.

RenTid provides a car for you or your team during working hours.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV with a photo, including:

  • Who you are

  • How long you have worked in cleaning

  • Your experience with private homes

  • Any commercial cleaning experience

  • What you would like to develop within

  • Why you believe you would be a good fit for RenTid

Please write your application in English . Please mark your application: “The Journey”.

"I want to join the journey"

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.
