title: Legal Counsel @ Enity Bank Group
description:
Are you a curious and solution-oriented lawyer looking to further develop your expertise in the banking sector? Are you interested in working for a Nasdaq Stockholm-listed Nordic banking group with an innovative and friendly culture?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Enity Bank Group's Finnish branch** as a new **Legal Counsel**! This is a broad in-house role where you will be the key legal point of contact for Enity Bank Group's Finnish operations, while working closely with the wider legal team across the Nordic organisation. You will be the sole lawyer in Finland, while having the support of your legal colleagues across the Nordics whenever needed.

_Enity believes in people's potential and is challenging the Nordic mortgage market by making banking more inclusive, sustainable and human. As a listed company, Enity operates through the brands Bluestep Bank, Bank2 and 60plusbanken, offering mortgages to customers often excluded by traditional banks – for example, due to self-employment, type of employment, age or credit history – as well as savings products. The Group operates across Sweden, Norway and Finland and is entering its next phase of growth, with an ambition to develop through new products, partnerships, distribution models and M&A. In Finland, Enity operates through a local branch of Enity Bank Group AB (publ)._

**In this role**, you will support the Finnish business on a wide range of legal and regulatory matters, with a particular focus on mortgage lending, consumer credit and the day-to-day legal needs of the branch. The role offers significant independence and close interaction with both the local business and colleagues across the Group. In more concrete terms, you will:

- provide legal advice to the Finnish branch on a broad range of matters

- support the mortgage business on matters relating to lending, security, property law, consumer protection, debt collection and insolvency

- review marketing materials and customer communications from a legal and regulatory perspective

- review and negotiate commercial agreements

- support the business in relation to customer matters, complaints and disputes

- monitor relevant Finnish legislation and regulatory developments and support their implementation within the branch

- advise on regulatory requirements applicable to the Finnish operations and support interactions with relevant authorities when needed

- prepare internal legal guidance and training

- support the Group in connection with potential acquisitions and other strategic transactions, including legal due diligence, transaction documentation and integration-related matters


The position is based in Helsinki and reports to the Bank's CLO, who is based in Stockholm. You will be part of the Nordic Legal team and collaborate closely with legal colleagues across the Group. In Finland, you will act as the main legal point of contact for the local organisation and work closely with the Branch Manager for Finland, contributing to the continued development and growth of Enity Bank Group's business in Finland.

**This role would be ideal for a legal professional who:**

- has a Finnish master's degree in law and at least three years of relevant post-qualification experience (however this is just the minimum requirement, and the role has plenty to offer a more senior lawyer as well) preferably from a bank, financial institution, law firm or other regulated business;

- has experience from one or more of the following areas: banking and finance, mortgage lending or other consumer credit, consumer protection, insolvency, debt collection or disputes or financial regulation;

- is comfortable taking ownership of matters and working independently, while also collaborating closely with colleagues across different functions and jurisdictions;

- can translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear, practical advice and is interested in understanding the commercial context in which you work; and

- has excellent communication skills in Finnish and English. Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.


**Enity Bank Group offers you:**

- a versatile position with excellent opportunities for professional growth;

- a front row seat in a growing company, where you have the opportunity to influence and gain responsibility;

- a supportive and close-knit culture with shared moments, such as after-works, company get-togethers and events; and

- the possibility to travel occasionally and to work as a part of a Nordic team with colleagues in Stockholm and Oslo.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **5 October 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi). We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period, so don't wait to apply!

title: Apulaisravintolapäällikkö
description:
Lillan Hotel & Kök kasvaa ja kehittyy – nyt sinulla on mahdollisuus tulla mukaan rakentamaan sen menestystä seuraavassa tarinan luvussa!

Olemme viiden pienosakkaan omistama, Tampereen ainoa boutique-hotelli sekä monipuolinen ja laadukas ravintola, jossa yhdistyvät kodinomaisuus, lämmin ylellisyys ja henkilökohtainen, läsnäoleva palvelu. Yritys tunnetaan vahvasta kasvusta sekä modernista ja kannattavasta toimintamallista, joka nojaa strategiseen johtamiseen, jatkuvaan kehittämiseen ja korkeaan asiakastyytyväisyyteen. Etsimme apulaisravintolapäällikköä toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vastaamaan ravintolamme operatiivisesta toiminnasta, henkilöstön johtamisesta sekä kehittämään asiakaskokemusta yhdessä sitoutuneen tiimin ja esihenkilöiden kanssa.

Apulaisravintolapäällikkönä vastaat ravintolan päivittäisestä operatiivisesta toiminnasta, henkilöstön johtamisesta, perehdyttämisestä ja työvuorosuunnittelusta, asiakaskokemuksen ja palvelun laadun varmistamisesta, ravintolapalveluiden, tapahtumien ja tilaisuuksien johtamisesta, niiden ja tuotteidemme kehittämisestä yhteistyössä johtotiimin kanssa sekä taloudellisesta työskentelystä, myynnin ja kannattavuuden kehityksestä. Myös toimintaympäristön ja tilojen kunnossapito sekä työsuojeluvelvoitteiden ja viranomaisvaatimusten noudattaminen ovat osa päivittäistä työskentelyäsi.

Etsimme sinua, joka omaat vahvaa kokemusta ravintola-alan esihenkilö- tai johtotehtävistä Johdat henkilöstöä vahvalla organisointikyvyllä, vastuullisuudella ja vahvistaen koko tiimiä. Vastuullista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta, sekä vahvaa asiakaspalvelu- ja palveluliiketoiminnan ymmärrystä. Ymmärrät taloudellisen johtamisen ja yhdistät sen laadukkaisiin palveluihin ja asiakaskokemuksiin. Puhut sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kieltä.

Eduksi katsotaan aiempaa kokemusta hotelli- ja/tai ravintolaympäristössä työskentelystä sekä intohimoa pienten elämysten luomiseen kaikissa palveluissamme, ruoka- ja juomatuotteita ja tapahtumia kohtaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle näköalapaikan ja vahvan roolin kasvavassa, modernia palvelualan toimintaa ja kannattavaa liiketoimintaa tuottavassa yrityksessämme. Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa, kehittää ja jättää jälkesi ainutlaatuiseen konseptiin, inspiroivan työympäristön poikkeuksellisessa ja historiallisessa miljöössä sekä ammattitaitoisen ja motivoituneen työyhteisön, yrityksemme resurssit ja kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksen mukaan.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si osoitteeseen operatiiviselle johtajallemme lasse@lillan.fi tai toimitusjohtajallemme mirella@lillan.fi viimeistään 23.10.

Hakemuksia käsitellään hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään sopivan hakijan löydyttyä.

title: Asumisen avustaja, Riihitien palvelukoti, Liperi
description:

Pidätkö ruoanlaitosta, siivoamisesta ja viihtyisän ympäristön luomisesta? Haluatko tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten päivittäisessä elämässä?

- hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja suomen kielen taidon


- kiinnostusta työskennellä kehitysvammaisten henkilöiden kanssa.


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- määräaikaisen työsuhteen vähintään 29.11.2026 asti sekä säännölliset arkipäiviin sijoittuvat työvuorot


- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisen palkan (palkkaluokka G16A/G18B koulutustaustan mukaan)


- merkityksellisen työn osana asumispalveluiden arkea


- työyhteisön tuen ja perehdytyksen tehtäviisi


- mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omia vahvuuksiasi ja osaamistasi.


**Tule toteuttamaan hyvää arkea**

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 11.10.2026 osoitteeseen rekrytointi@hl-s.fi tai käyttäen verkkosivujemme hakulomaketta (https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/). Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään pikaisesti, heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palvelukotivastaava Kirsi Juvonen, puh. 050 388 6639.

_Tule mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme pykälää parempaa arkea. Honkalampi-säätiössä teemme työtä, jotta kenenkään unelmat eivät jäisi olosuhteiden tai tuen puutteen vuoksi toteutumatta. Meillä johtaminen tapahtuu arjessa ja ihmisten keskellä – meillä koti on koti._

title: Business Controller, Vianor
description:
Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

We are looking for a Business Controller, Vianor to join our team.

The Business Controller, Vianor acts as a senior finance business partner to the Vianor business leadership, providing financial insight, analysis and challenge to support performance management, profitability improvement and strategic decision-making. The role combines strong business understanding, disciplined financial planning and reporting, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear business actions.

Key responsibilities:

- ·Financial leadership and business partnering: Provide proactive financial support, challenge and insights to Vianor business leadership and country organizations. Act as a trusted sparring partner in identifying performance drivers, risks, opportunities and concrete improvement actions.
- Performance management and profitability analysis: Lead analysis of business performance across sales, margin, cost, operating profit, working capital and cash flow. Support the business in understanding key profitability drivers, including customer, product, country and price-volume-mix dynamics.
- Planning, forecasting and budgeting: Own and coordinate key financial planning processes for Vianor, including monthly estimates, annual budgeting and long-range planning, in close cooperation with business leadership and country finance teams.
- Reporting and financial transparency: Ensure timely, accurate and meaningful financial reporting for Vianor and support country companies in monthly reporting. Continuously improve reporting quality, management insight and visualization of key financial information.
- Investment, business case and strategic support: Support business development, investment decisions, expansion initiatives and M&A-related activities by providing robust financial analysis, business case modelling and standardized evaluation methods.
- Process, tools and ways-of-working development: Drive continuous improvement of financial processes, planning practices, reporting tools and analytical methods. Promote efficient use of systems, data and digital tools, including business intelligence and AI-supported analysis.
- Governance, controls and audit support: Support sound financial governance, internal cost allocation, inventory-related follow-up and audit processes for Vianor and relevant country companies.

What we expect from you:

- A masters degree, preferably in finance, accounting or economics.
- Solid experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis, reporting or a comparable senior finance role, preferably in an international, multi-entity environment.
- Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, profitability drivers and financial performance management.
- Proven ability to act as a business partner to senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and convert financial analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Experience in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, investment analysis and business case modelling.

title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

title: Senior Product Manager for BeeHealthy, Finland / Germany
description:
Senior Product Manager, BeeHealthy

Join us in our mission to make care smarter!

At BeeHealthy, we're on a mission to make care smarter through our configurable, white-label SaaS platform. We combine over 115 years of healthcare expertise with modern technology, serving social, healthcare, and veterinary providers alongside insurance organisations in over 10 countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

We're a team of 90+, with 60+ in our product organisation, growing fast and looking for people who want to do meaningful work. If you care about impact, quality, and building products that genuinely improve how care is delivered and received, we'd love to hear from you.

Location: Helsinki, Turku, Tampere, or Jyväskylä (Finland) or Berlin (Germany)
Working mode: Remote-friendly, hybrid working model

About the Role
You will own the what and the why for your product area, from discovery through launch and iteration. You will work closely with Engineering and Design to turn strategy into a clear product direction, make the tough calls on scope and tradeoffs, and ensure teams build the right things. This role is a strong fit for someone with a technical background who wants to build product in healthcare: a regulated, complex industry that runs on both B2B and B2C dynamics at once.

We are a company of about 100 people, and everyone here operates with a business owner mindset. Even at senior level, this role stays hands-on: you are accountable for the outcome, not just the output, and you build alongside the team rather than direct from a distance.

What you will do
Own the product strategy for your area, contributing to the bigger goal of making healthcare smarter
Stay on top of market knowledge, competitors, and the wider healthcare structure, so your decisions hold up commercially, not just technically
Run the end-to-end product management process for your domain, from discovery to delivery to feedback loops
Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, and commercial teams, turning customer insight into a roadmap the whole group can align behind
Work as a technical partner to engineering: understand the trade-offs, and use that understanding to push for product decisions that add real user value, not just ship features
Build compliance into the product from the start, working with frameworks like GDPR, MDR, EHDS, and national health data regulations, so requirements don't cost you rework or slip your timelines later

What you bring
5+ years in product management at a SaaS company, ideally already at senior level
Real comfort working close to engineering: APIs, integrations, platform architecture. Prior experience on a core platform team or in a highly technical environment is a strong plus
Solid product management craft, with experience in B2B
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
A natural team player: humble, hands-on, high energy, drawn to solving problems rather than just describing them
Fluent English, with the ability to express yourself clearly and present confidently to different audiences

Bonus points
Background in Fintech, Healthcare, or Gambling/Gaming, or another complex, highly regulated industry
Experience across B2B2C environments; direct experience building or significantly evolving a CRM platform is a strong plus
Experience in a scale-up
Exposure to healthcare products such as Epic/MyChart or similar patient portal / EHR platforms
Experience with authentication or identity systems (OIDC, SAML, OAuth 2.0)
International experience, having worked across multiple markets or countries
German, Italian, Spanish, Arabic, or other languages

Benefits
Generous, Nordic-style paid holiday
Flexible remote-work policy and working hours
Wide range of IT equipment to choose from
Comprehensive occupational healthcare
Sponsored sports or culture memberships
Healthy snacks, and drinks at the office
Regular team days, game nights, and social events

Culture at BeeHealthy
At BeeHealthy, freedom and responsibility go hand in hand. You'll be trusted to work independently while collaborating closely with your colleagues, sharing knowledge, learning continuously, and respecting each other both professionally and personally.
Our culture is guided by strong values:
Skill and Knowledge: we never stop learning.
Caring and Responsibility: we look out for each other and the people who use what we build.
Partners and Entrepreneurship: we innovate through collaboration.
Growth and Development: we're committed to unlocking potential, both for ourselves and our customers.

We're a close-knit, international team where talent and knowledge-sharing thrive. We believe that building great healthcare technology starts with taking care of the people who build it.

Recruitment process
We read every application: Once the application period closes, we take time to review everyone who applied. You'll hear back from us, whatever the outcome.
Short meeting with our VP Talent: A chance to get to know each other. The focus here is on bringing BeeHealthy's culture and values to life, and exploring how they resonate with your own.
Meeting with the hiring manager: This conversation goes deeper into the role, its responsibilities and expectations, as well as the requirements.
Team meeting and case assignment: You'll get to meet your future teammates and work through an engaging case.
Possible meeting with our C-level team.
Offer: When the right person meets the right role, we'll be in touch to make an offer and talk through the details together.

Apply by submitting your CV and a brief note about why this role excites you through our recruitment system by 18.10.2026. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you. Work starts per agreement.

title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Office
description:
Take AI from the frontier into the field.

The AI Office is a small team with a direct mandate from the CEO to make Bittium an AI-native company. We build the AI tools and infrastructure Bittium works with, and work inside our business segments to bring AI into their products.

We are hiring two new Members of Technical Staff to join the AI Office and work side by side with our Head of AI. What you build ends up in your colleagues' daily work and in products depended on by defence forces, public authorities and healthcare professionals.

You might be the person who

- has rewritten their own agent harness more than once.
- shipped a full app in a weekend for a team that wasn't yours, and they still use it.
- fine-tuned a model and knows whether the eval moving meant anything.
- had a new open-weights model running on their own hardware the day it came out, and had an opinion about it by lunch.
- was pushed by API pricing, or dreams of personal AI sovereignty, into squeezing a model onto hardware it had no business running on.
- has broken a guardrail, and knows why you never rely on just one.
- daydreams of dark software factories.

What you will do

We shape the role around the person, and we make room for exceptional people. If your strength isn't listed below, tell us.

- Keep us ahead. You live and breathe the AI takeoff: the models, the hardware, the tools and where the whole industry is heading. Separate what matters from the noise early, and steer where we put our effort.
- Go where the work is. Sit with legal, finance, sales, R&D or production, find the work AI should be doing, and build it fast.
- Run and grow our AI infrastructure and applications. Inference on our own GPUs, the services on top of it and the end-user applications people work with every day. When a new model is worth having, it is live the same week.
- Build the AI our products run on. Build and maintain the agent harnesses, models and safeguards our business segments build products on, and keep them working all the way out to battlefield conditions.
- Make models ours. Post-train open-weights models until they beat the general-purpose ones at our work.
- Make agents safe to trust. Alignment on the model side, and a hard boundary around it that holds even when the model gets it wrong.

What we are looking for above all

Taste. You know what good looks like in code, in interfaces and in products, and you don't ship less. You look for the simple solution even when it takes longer to find, because clarity is worth the effort, but you also know when to take a shortcut.

An edge. At work or outside it, you have taken something further than most people ever do. We care about that far more than titles, degrees or years of experience.

Ownership. We set the direction together, and you own what you build and answer for the results. Lots of freedom, lots of responsibility, so you need to be good at directing your own work.

What we ask

- You have mastered the craft of working with language models: prompting, context, agent skills, multi-agent orchestration and compiling intent into working software, including the spells that make the difference.
- You build real software, fast, with coding agents, and you have opinions about where agentic development is going. One thing is sure: the future is not TUIs on laptops.
- A strong full-stack engineer: frontend, APIs, databases, auth and deployment (ours is mostly Go, Python, TypeScript, SolidJS, Svelte and Postgres today, but we don't hire for a stack). You take a tool from an empty repo to production on your own.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals: architecture, data modelling, clean interfaces, testing, Linux and networking. When agents write the code, fundamentals are how you judge it.
- An eye for opportunity. You have a vision. You spot what should be automated and where a product is hiding, and you find the real problem behind a request, working easily with people who are not engineers.
- Fluent English and at least working Finnish.

Any of these will make you stand out

- Security: agent sandboxing, red or blue team experience.
- Evals: designing evals that measure what matters in real work, and knowing when a good number is misleading.
- AI products: you have taken an AI-driven product or technology from idea to production, with real users or customers relying on it.
- Inference and GPU systems: SGLang or vLLM internals, speculative decoding, disaggregated serving, KV-cache offloading, low-bit quantization, kernels in Triton or CUDA, ROCm.
- Infrastructure and trust: confidential computing and attestation, bare metal, AWS or other cloud.
- Model training: post-training, preference optimization, RL, distillation, datasets, alignment and safety.
- AI hardware beyond NVIDIA: AMD, Tenstorrent, Cerebras, Etched, hardwired inference silicon, NPUs and other edge accelerators.
- Classic ML and sensing: anomaly detection, RF signal processing, biosignals (ECG, EEG), computer vision, sensor fusion.
- Mission-critical and regulated domains: defence, public safety, critical infrastructure or healthcare.

What we offer

- Interesting work, above all.
- The best tools for the job: frontier (and?) open-weights models, and our own GPUs to experiment on.
- Real influence on where Bittium takes AI.
- Work that matters for Europe's security, where reliability is not optional. Competitive pay and Bittium's employee benefits.
- Hybrid work in Oulu or Espoo.

How to apply

Enclose your CV, a link to or attachment of your best work, and a few lines about something you have taken further than most people. We will start interviewing shortlisted candidates during the application period.

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. As a Service Instructor, you will work under the supervision of your manager and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at customer sites. You will work responsibly and ensure that tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with agreed quality standards and operating practices. Acting as a key link between employees, management, and customers, you will support your supervisor in daily operations. Please note that this role does not include formal managerial responsibilities.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and success requires a customer-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills. In your role, you will have a direct impact on the customer experience and the success of customer relationships. Active collaboration, clear communication, and a solution-oriented approach are essential for this position.

**Your responsibilities include**

- Continuously developing operations together with your supervisor and actively contributing improvement ideas

- Guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- Collaborating with customers

- Regular participation in practical cleaning work


**What we expect from you**

- Ability to guide and support colleagues in daily situations, promote an inclusive and respectful work environment, and provide clear feedback

- Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach

- A customer-focused working style and positive attitude

- Ability to work under pressure and solve problems effectively

If one language is fluent, the other can be at a basic working level. We value a diverse workplace where different languages and cultural backgrounds are seen as strengths.

- If you are not a Finnish citizen, you must have a valid work permit

- A valid driver's license and the possibility to use your own car, as the working area is extensive and the role requires travel between sites

- Previous experience in cleaning services. Knowledge of commercial cleaning and cleaning industry qualifications are considered an advantage


**What we offer**

- A permanent full-time employment contract, 37.5 hours per week

- Shifts on weekdays and weekends, including early morning, morning, daytime, and evening shifts

- Start date to be agreed upon separately

- Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy

- Fair employment terms, a safe working environment, and support for employee well-being

- Competitive salary in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Property Services Employees, €2,235/month


**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and respectfully and do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to maintaining a safe and well-being-focused workplace.

**Did you know?**

People enjoy working at N-Clean. Our employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS) is an outstanding **55**. This is reflected in the way we value one another and in our ability to work and succeed together.

N-Clean has been recognized in the HUMAN POWER competition for several consecutive years, reflecting our long-term commitment to creating a people-centered and responsible working life. In 2024, we were named the Most Human-Centric Workplace, and in 2025, we achieved 3rd place overall and 3rd place in Finland's Most Human-Centric Working Life Act category. These recognitions highlight our people-focused recruitment approach, where meaningful encounters, respect, and an excellent candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.

**Join our top team!**

**Submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 8 October 2026.**

Please note that we review applications during the application period and may close the recruitment process before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

Applications are accepted only through the application form on our website.

title: POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
description:
POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
The University of Helsinki, Department of Chemistry, invites applications for a postdoctoral or doctoral researcher position in photocatalytic radical chemistry at the newly established Lahdenperä Group. Initially, the position is fixed-term for 12-months with a possibility of an extension.
Position description
The successful candidate will join an organic chemistry research group at the Department of Chemistry located at Kumpula campus. The research group aims to develop new concepts for controlling radical reactivity in photocatalytic transformations. The project focuses on the development of new approaches for controlling radical reactivity through hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) at surfaces and interfaces.
The project will involve:
* Development and optimisation of photocatalytic radical transformations
* Mechanistic studies of radical reactions and detailed investigation of HAT processes.
* Surface functionalization and interface chemistry.
* Design and synthesis of organic molecules.

The postdoctoral researcher will additionally be expected to contribute to the supervision of students and participate in future funding applications.
Requirements
Postdoctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a PhD degree in chemistry or a closely related field by the start of employment, or be close to completion of their doctoral studies.
Consideration will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:
* synthetic organic chemistry.
* photocatalysis, radical chemistry, hydrogen atom transfer processes.
* reaction mechanism studies.
* flow chemistry.

The successful candidate should demonstrate the ability to conduct independent research and publish scientific results in international peer-reviewed journals.
Doctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in chemistry or a closely related discipline that qualifies them for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki.
Previous experience in organic synthesis, photochemistry, catalysis or related experimental chemistry is advantageous but not required.
Selected candidates for the interview process will be required to provide a copy of their university transcript before interview date.
For both positions
We are looking for candidates who are:
* highly motivated and scientifically curious.
* willing to develop new experimental skills.
* persistent and independent in tackling challenging research questions.

Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.
Salary and benefits
The salary follows the salary system of University salary system and is based on the researcher's qualifications, experience, and stage of doctoral or postdoctoral career.
For postdoctoral researchers, the starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
For doctoral researcher the starting salary will be approximately 2600–2800 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to the University of Helsinki. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from different gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities to apply for the position. You can read about the accessibility and inclusivity of our university via this link.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* Curriculum vitae, including a publication list (if applicable).
* A concise motivation letter describing your research interests, relevant experience, reasons for applying and career plans. Please indicate your desired starting date in the application.
* Degree certificate (PhD for postdoctoral applicants; Master's degree for doctoral researcher applicants).

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
The deadline for applications is October 16th, 2026.
Ideally, the selected candidate will start as soon as possible, although flexibility in the starting date can be arranged. Regardless, candidates who are unable to start immediately are still encouraged to apply. The selected applicants will be given support to apply for available grants or fellowships.
Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until a suitable candidate is found. Interviews may start before closing date 16.10.2026.
Additional information
Further information about the position can be obtained from Dr. Antti Lahdenperä, antti.sk.lahdenpera@helsinki.fi.

title: Kotisiivooja – Helsinki ja Espoo
description:
**Services Netto Oy** hakee itsenäisiä, huolellisia ja luotettavia kotisiivoojia Helsingin ja Espoon alueelle. Työ sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy itsenäisessä ja liikkuvassa työssä sekä haluaa vaikuttaa omiin työvuoroihinsa.

**Työtehtävät**

Kotisiivoojana työskentelet asiakkaidemme kodeissa ja huolehdit niiden siisteydestä ja viihtyvyydestä. Kokeneemmille työntekijöille voimme tarjota myös erikoissiivoustehtäviä, kuten raivaussiivouksia. Työtehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa:

- imurointi ja lattioiden pesu

- pölyjen ja pintojen pyyhintä

- keittiön siivous

- kylpyhuoneen ja WC-tilojen siivous

- muut asiakkaan kanssa sovitut kodin siivoustehtävät.


Työ on liikkuvaa kotisiivoustyötä, ja työpäivän aikana siirryt asiakkaalta toiselle. Kuljetat työssä tarvittavat siivousvälineet ja -tarvikkeet mukanasi repussa asiakaskohteesta toiseen.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme sinulta:

- oma-aloitteista ja itsenäistä työotetta

- huolellisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä

- perussiivouksen hallintaa

- valmiutta liikkua eri asiakaskohteiden välillä Helsingin ja Espoon alueella.


Aikaisempi kokemus kotisiivouksesta tai muista siivoustehtävistä katsotaan eduksi. Ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus ovat myös eduksi, mutta eivät välttämättömiä.

**Työaika ja työsuhde**

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääasiassa arkipäiville, eikä työ sisällä viikonlopputyötä. Voit vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi ja työskennellä osa-aikaisesti tai keikkaluonteisesti omaan elämäntilanteeseesi sopivalla tavalla.

- **Työaika:** 0–38 tuntia viikossa

- **Työskentelyalue:** Helsinki ja Espoo

- **Työn aloitus:** Sopimuksen mukaan


**Palkkaus**

Palkkaus määräytyy Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.

**Tuntipalkka: 12,59 €/h + mahdolliset TES mukaiset lisät.**

**Hakeminen**

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja CV sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: **tyohakemukset(a)servicesnetto.com**

Kerro hakemuksessasi aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi, käytettävyydestäsi sekä siitä, kuinka monta tuntia viikossa olet kiinnostunut työskentelemään.

**Services Netto Oy** tarjoaa mahdollisuuden joustavaan työskentelyyn sekä itsenäiseen työhön erilaisissa asiakaskohteissa. Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja, Jyväskylä, Kuokkala (viite 40150)
description:
Haemme Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialueen henkilökohtaisen avun keskuksen kautta avustajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 13.12.2026 asti, 28-vuotiaalle naiselle Jyväskylän Kuokkalaan. Työsuhde voi mahdollisesti jatkua määräaikaisen työsuhteen jälkeen.

Työnantajan sairauden vuoksi hänen toimintakykynsä vaihtelee. Työnantaja liikkuu ulkona pyörätuolilla. Työ ei sisällä nostoja ja siirtoja. Työnantaja on hajusteyliherkkä.

Työtä tarjotaan vaihtelevasti 8 h/vko päivittäisiin toimiin ja 30 h/kk vapaa-aikaan. Työtunnit jaetaan toisen avustajan kanssa sopimuksen mukaan. Työvuorot suunnitellaan työsuhteessa.

Työ alkaa sopivan avustajan löydyttyä.

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Hae työpaikkaa lähettämällä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen havu.keskus@hyvaks.fi. Liitä hakemukseesi tämän työpaikkailmoituksen oma viitetieto. Välitämme hakemuksesi työnantajalle.

title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with (#Ericsson) mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance
Interested?

Submit your CV and wanted information to our candidate database as soon as possible. We review candidates continuously and aim to identify suitable specialists quickly.

More information arja.martikainen@barona.fi

title: Työhönvalmentaja
description:

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja

- kykyä työskennellä tavoitteellisesti sekä itsenäisesti että verkostoissa

Tarjoamme:

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Kuopion alueelle
description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Kuopion alueelle. Aloitus on mahdollisimman pian, joten toivomme hakemustasi pikaisesti.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


**Edellytämme sinulta**

- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä

- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti


Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi.

title: Office Coordinator (part-time), Nordic Semiconductor Finland, Tampere
description:
About the role

In this part-time role, you will be the heart of our Tampere office, ensuring a welcoming environment for employees and guests. Working closely with our Oulu-based support team, you will manage daily logistics, coordinate fun social events, and keep our workspace organized.

You are offered a highly flexible part-time schedule (40-50%, about 2 days a week) that can be distributed across the week to fit your lifestyle. Enjoy a respectful, stress-free work environment where work-life balance is truly prioritized.

Work tasks
- Coordinate daily office operations and maintain a welcoming, tidy environment
- Organize office social events, staff gatherings, and traditional "fika" moments
- Prepare meeting rooms, including catering, cleanliness, and checking AV/IT equipment
- Manage office supplies, general procurement, and incoming/outgoing deliveries
- Welcome visitors and provide general front-desk support
- Act as the main point of contact for facility maintenance, cleaning, and equipment vendors

We are looking for

- A proactive, empathetic, and highly organized approach to work
- Fluent English skills and at least B-level (good) Finnish skills
- Experience in service-minded roles such as retail, hospitality, or customer service
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools

It is meritorious if you have
- Basic knowledge of AI tools and Canva
- Norwegian and/or Swedish language skills

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process. To join us in a part-time role, youll need another main activity that covers at least 50% of your time. That could be studies, another job, running your own business, parental leave, or something similar.

title: Tarjoilukeittiön keittiötyöntekijä Keisarinnaan
description:
**Oletko se ihminen, jonka ansiosta Keisarinnan tarjoilukeittiö toimii?**

Me uskomme, että jokaisessa keittiössä on yksi ihminen, joka pitää langat käsissään. Hän huomaa, jos jokin asia on jäämässä tekemättä. Hän pitää huolen siitä, että asiat tapahtuvat ajallaan. Hän löytää sujuvamman tavan tehdä asioita ja nauttii siitä, kun arki rullaa – ei siksi, että hän juoksisi sinne tänne, vaan siksi, että hänen työnsä sujuu hyvällä mielellä. Nyt etsimme tätä ihmistä meille.

**Kototiimi kasvaa vauhdilla – ja tarvitsemme kasvun mahdollistajan keittiöön**

Tällä hetkellä Kototiimillä on kaksi hoivakotia (kurkkaa www.kototiimi.fi). Kolmas avaa ovensa lokakuussa. Kasvun mukana lisääntyvät myös asiakkaat, tarjoiltavat ateriat ja välipalat, tiski, herkkujen tarve ja juhlien suunnittelu jne. Siksi tarvitsemme Keisarinnan keittiöön avainhenkilön – ihmisen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus pysyy hallinnassa.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain osa keittiötä. Olet Keisarinnan sydän.

**Mitä työsi käytännössä on?**

Työsi tärkein vastuu on saada päivittäiset ateriat turvallisesti ja kauniisti tarjolle (ateriat tulevat valmiina eli emme valmista lounasta ja päivällistä), pitää keittiö siistinä, suunnitella välipaloja ja leivonnaisia sekä huolehtia, että tarvikkeita on riittävästi. Toki myös keittiön omavalvonnasta huolehtiminen on vastuullasi. Huolehdit siitä, että tarjoilukeittiö toimii täsmällisesti, ajallaan ja laadukkaasti. Sinulle tarkkuus ei ole rasite, vaan tapa tehdä työtä. Toimit myös osana Keisarinnan tiimiä. Perehdytät, neuvot ja kehität toimintaa aterioiden ja keittiön näkökulmasta yhdessä muiden kanssa. Haluamme, että osaaminen kasvaa koko tiimissä – ei vain yhdellä ihmisellä. Kaikki auttavat toisiaan, koska meillä yksi asia yhdistää kaikkia: **Ketään ei jätetä yksin.**

**Me innostumme ihmisistä, jotka kehittävät.**

Ehkä huomaat usein miettiväsi:\_"Tämän voisi tehdä vähän fiksummin."\_Silloin saatat viihtyä meillä erinomaisesti. Emme etsi ihmistä, joka vain ylläpitää nykyisiä toimintatapoja. Etsimme ihmistä, joka uskaltaa kysyä, voisiko tämän tehdä paremmin. Kasvavassa yrityksessä mikään ei ole valmiiksi kiveen hakattua. Juuri siksi pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, millaiseksi Kototiimin Keisarinna rakentuu.

**Millainen sinä olet?**

Pidät järjestyksestä. Nautit siitä, että asiat ovat järjestyksessä ja tehtynä ajallaan. Rakastat työskennellä keittiössä. Vaikka meillä et valmista ruokaa alusta asti, pidät leipomisesta ja muusta värkkäämisestä ruoan ympärillä.

Sinulla on kokemusta keittiötyöstä, leipomisesta ja keittiöhygieniasta. Tai ehkä polkusi on ollut aivan toisenlainen. Meille tärkeintä on asenne.

**Mitä saat meiltä?**

Saat vakituisen työn yrityksessä, joka kasvaa voimakkaasti ja jossa omaan työhön voi oikeasti vaikuttaa. Saat vastuuta, luottamusta ja mahdollisuuden rakentaa toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Saat työyhteisön, jossa autetaan toisia, iloitaan onnistumisista ja tehdään töitä yhteisen tavoitteen eteen. Ja mikä tärkeintä – saat työn, jolla on valtava merkitys asiakkaillemme.

Vaikka et työskentelisi päivittäin asukkaidemme kanssa, vaikutat siihen, että heidän arkensa toimii. Kun keittiö toimii hyvin, koko hoivakotiyhteisö toimii hyvin.

**Jos tunnistit itsesi...**

...älä jää miettimään, täytätkö jokaisen kohdan. Jos ajattelet, että voisit olla juuri se ihminen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus toimii vähän paremmin, haluamme kuulla sinusta. Tule rakentamaan Kototiimin seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta. Meillä tärkeimmät työt eivät aina näy ulospäin – mutta niiden vaikutus näkyy joka päivä.

title: Doctoral researcher in computational weld mechanics
description:
Do you want to build a research career in computational weld mechanics? Join LUT University as a doctoral researcher and become part of an international research team developing advanced simulation methods for welded high-strength steel structures.

What your work will be like

Your work will focus on the analysis of local heat-affected zone (HAZ) behaviour in welded high-strength steels through computational weld mechanics (CWM) and phase-transformation modelling.
The research combines thermo-metallurgical and phase-transformation modelling, simulation of microstructural evolution in weld heat-affected zones, and modelling of local mechanical properties such as hardness, strength and strain-hardening behaviour. In addition, the work includes experimental characterisation of welded joints using microstructural, thermal and mechanical measurements and the validation of predictive models for performance-driven design of welded structures.

You will contribute to the development of next-generation simulation methods capable of accurately predicting local property variations in welded high-strength fossil-free steel structures.

You will be part of the Welding Technology Unit and the Steel Structures Unit at the LUT School of Energy Systems. Approximately 25 researchers are involved in these units, which collaborate closely with national and international partner universities, such as University of Oulu (Finland), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Sweden) and Chemnitz University of Technology (Germany).

What we expect from you

You have a master's degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in a relevant field such as mechanical engineering, materials engineering, welding engineering, computational mechanics, or another relevant discipline, and the ability and motivation to complete the doctoral studies within their normative duration (i.e. four years).

A solid background in numerical modelling, materials science, solid mechanics, finite element methods, programming, and/or welding technology is considered beneficial. Success in this position requires the ability to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively within our international research community. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required for performing the duties of this role.

We expect a willingness to travel, as the position includes project-related travel within Finland, participation in international conferences, and opportunities for research mobility with partner universities in Europe.

The selected candidate must submit an application for the right to complete doctoral studies with all required appendices to the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of the employment relationship.

What we offer

At LUT, you will have the opportunity to develop your scientific expertise and research skills. Our experienced supervisors will guide you, and you will benefit from professional development opportunities.

The position is based at the Lappeenranta campus, and you are expected to be regularly present on site.

The employment relationship will start with a one-year term (including a six-month trial period) and may be extended for up to three additional years, depending on the progress of your studies and research.

The work starts in December 2026. The start date is negotiable. Working hours are flexible, supporting work-life balance, with a total of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities.

The salary is determined according to the Finnish university salary system (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Interested? Please submit your application by 15 October 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+2h). Fill out the online application form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format:

- A cover letter describing your motivation and suitability specifically for this position, based on your expertise acquired during studies and potential prior work experience

- A curriculum vitae (CV) following the guidelines of the [Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity](https://tenk.fi/sites/default/files/2021-06/TENK_CV_template_2020.pdf)

- Scanned copies of your original bachelors and masters degree certificates and transcripts of records; if the original documents are not in English or Finnish, each document must be accompanied by an official certified translation into English (or Finnish). If the degree is unfinished, please provide an official estimate of your graduation.

- Contact details of two references (if available)

- A list of publications (if any)

Each attachment field accepts only one file. If you wish to submit multiple files, please combine them into a single PDF before uploading.

We will review applications on a rolling basis. Please ensure that your application includes all required documents and is submitted through the recruitment system.

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tuomas Skriko (tuomas.skriko@lut.fi, +358 50 470 6518) or Assistant Professor Antti Ahola (antti.ahola@lut.fi, +358 50 475 2825), preferably by email. You can also reach them by phone on 25 September 2026 and 9 October 2026 from 14:00 to 15:00 (UTC+2).

Read more about [LUT as an employer](https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/lut-employer) and the [LUT Doctoral School](https://www.lut.fi/en/research/doctoral-school).

Explore [information for international staff](https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/international-staff-and-visitors)

LUT University | LUT University seeks solutions to global issues with its expertise in technology, business, and social sciences. LUT is a trailblazer in promoting the energy transition and the regenerative use of natural resources and helps build resilient communities, industry, and businesses through data, research, and education. LUT's campuses are in Lappeenranta and Lahti, Finland, but its impact is global. [Lut.fi/en](https://www.lut.fi/en)

title: Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Full Professor in Business Analytics (tenure track) / Biträdande professor (nivå 1), biträdande professor (nivå 2) eller professor inom affärsanalytik (tenure track)
description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

Hanken School of Economics invites applications for a tenure-track position in Business Analytics at the level of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Full Professor

starting on 1 January 2027, or as otherwise agreed, by 1 September 2027 at the latest. The position is based in Helsinki within the subject of Statistics, which is part of the Department of Finance and Economics.

The position is part of Hankens tenure-track system and is open to researchers with the potential for an outstanding academic career. If the position is filled at the Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to advance through evaluations that consider merits across all relevant areas in accordance with [Hankens tenure track guidelines](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system).

Hanken School of Economics is a research-oriented business school offering education in Swedish and English. The Statistics unit, which collaborates closely with Finance and Information Systems, conducts high-quality research on financial time series. The subject seeks to strengthen its teaching and research in the application of machine learning and business analytics. The subject offers education at the Bachelors, Masters, and doctoral levels.

The Department provides a strong research environment, reflected in the growing scope and breadth of its research activities. We value high-quality research with relevance to business and economics, as demonstrated by publications in highly ranked academic journals.

Requirements

The applicants will be reviewed based on their research, teaching, institutional service, and societal impact. Applicants for the current position are required to have a fluent command of both English and Swedish. Teaching in Swedish is expected as part of the position's responsibilities.

Applicants on the assistant professor level should hold a doctoral degree (or be near completion of their doctorate) with a quantitative research orientation (e.g., business analytics, data science, machine learning, management science, statistics, econometrics, quantitative economics, or applied mathematics). When evaluating the applicants qualifications, the main focus will be on the potential to conduct high-quality scientific research in key areas relevant to the position, including Business Analytics and the potential to provide high-quality teaching.

In addition to the requirements for an assistant professor, applicants for the associate professor level are expected to have demonstrated internationally high levels of research within the scientific field of the position, high levels in teaching and contributed through institutional service and societal impact.

Applicants for full professor must demonstrate that she or he is an internationally recognised researcher with continued internationally high levels of research within the scientific field of the position. A professor is also expected to demonstrate continued high levels in teaching, institutional service and societal impact. In addition, academic leadership, experience of PhD supervision, experience and success in applying competitive research funding, international research cooperation, academic expert assignments, and experience of service within an academic department, faculty and / or university are expected.

Academic staff at Hanken are expected to carry out and supervise scientific research, provide high-quality academic teaching, closely follow the advances of their field, and participate in service to Hanken, the academic community, and society.

The full-time position has an annual working time of 1612 hours. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. Teaching tasks are allocated based on the curriculum needs of the subject and by considering relevant own expertise.

Salary

The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (includes employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions). The exact salary level depends on the recruited individuals qualifications and performance. Hanken will support the selected employee with a start-up research budget, and additional research, travel and teaching development grants can also be applied for. Hanken rewards excellence in both research and teaching.

For more Information

For additional information, please contact Chair of the Department Committee, Professor Anders Löflund, anders.loflund@hanken.fi.

General instructions for applicants are provided [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process). Also, read more about Hanken as an employer [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/node/2413861).

Recruitment process and timeline

The application deadline is October 18th, 2026. Candidates will be interviewed online shortly after the application deadline. Short-listed candidates will be invited to on-site campus visits including an interview and research presentation.

How to apply

The application is to be addressed to the Rector and application materials should include:

- Cover letter in which the applicant specifies the position for which they are applying (professor, associate professor, or assistant professor)
- CV (proposed content [here](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)), including list of publications.
- Personal statement, which includes a description of past research and its scientific quality, academic impact, plans for future research and a description of the candidates service to the department and university and a description of the candidates societal impact.
- List of publications (with the most significant publications highlighted; maximum 10 for full professor applicants and maximum 5 for associate and assistant professor applicants. Applicants at the associate professor and full professor levels should additionally submit up to five publications for assessment.

title: Kalankäsittelijä, fish processer to Föglö, Åland Islands for Fish Industry, +6 months, AX- Föglö
description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for fish processer(s) to Föglö, Åland Islands.

The job involves many different functions at the fish factory: killing, gutting, "cleaning" the fish, "collecting" roe, packing, lifting heavy boxes, among other tasks. If you have forklift skills, you can also drive a counter balance forklift. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. At Nordic Trout/Bolt.works, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
The work requires decent general strength, endurance, and proactivity. Previous experience in fish processing jobs is a plus but not necessary. You will receive orientation to the job. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. Finnish hygiene passport will be needed but we can train it for the right person. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5hr/week
- Salary: approx. 12-13 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Contract length: approx. 6 months, with good possibility to continue further as permanent employment
- Start date: Sometime during October
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has small grocery store, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car/bus. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Etsimme nyt kalankäsittelijää Föglöön, Ahvenanmaalle.

Työtehtävät pitävät sisällään monipuolisia toimintoja kalatehtaalla: kalan teurastusta, perkausta, "putsaamista", mädin keruuta, pakkaamista sekä raskaiden laatikoiden nostelua. Jos sinulla on trukin ajotaitoja, voit ajaa myös vastapainotrukkia. Työskentelyolosuhteet ovat viileät (noin +2 – +6 °C), joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Nordic Troutilla / Bolt.worksilla pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todella yhteisöllistä "työperhettä".

Kelle työ sopii?
Työ vaatii kohtalaista yleiskuntoa, kestävyyttä ja oma-aloitteisuutta. Aiempi kokemus kalankäsittelystä on plusa, mutta ei välttämätöntä – saat työhön perehdytyksen. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka nauttii luonnon läheisyydestä, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella saaristossa. Hygieniapassi vaaditaan, mutta voimme kouluttaa sen oikealle henkilölle. Sinun tulee pystyä kommunikoimaan englanniksi sujuvan tiimityöskentelyn takaamiseksi.

- Työaika: 20–37,5 t/vk
- Palkka: n. 12–13 €/h kokemuksesta riippuen
- Sopimuksen kesto: n. 6 kuukautta, hyvä mahdollisuus jatkua vakituisena työsuhteena
- Aloitus: Lokakuun aikana
- TES: Elintarvikealan työehtosopimus
- Työsuhde: Bolt.worksin kautta

Tietoa työpaikasta ja käytännön järjestelyistä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupunkipalveluita: saarella on pieni ruokakauppa, kirjasto ja kuntosali, kun taas muut palvelut löytyvät Maarianhaminasta (35 min lautalla + 30 min autolla/bussilla). Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee majoituksen lähellä ja Maarianhaminaan kulkee bussi. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: yleensä asut toisen työntekijän kanssa kaksiossa. Vuokra on noin 300–450 €, ja se voi sisältää tai olla sisältämättä sähköä/vettä asunnosta riippuen (saat tarkat tiedot työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout on Suomen kalatoimialan suurin toimija sekä edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, tukkukaupassa, tuonnissa, viennissä ja kasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuotta panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin ja työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändi tarjoaa laajan valikoiman herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Hae paikkaa pian: tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: ERP Service Manager – Wärtsilä
description:
About the role

In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day operational cadence of Wärtsiläs ERP Application Development (Minor Enhancements). Following a major ERP transformation, our development machinery is accelerating, and we need a hands-on ERP Service Manager to act as the key operational glue between internal business workgroups and our external development partner.

You will manage the daily operations of enhancement requests, keeping monthly planning cycles, 1-month sprints, and SAP release dates strictly on track. Your primary focus will be supporting Wärtsilä's organization in operational delivery and ensuring our external offshore partner achieves high throughput and quality.

What can we offer to you
- Permanent and full-time work contract as Academic Work consultant at Wärtsilä
- Salary: about 4,000–6,000 EUR/month based on your background and skillset. For highly experienced candidates, a higher salary level may also be negotiated.
- Impactful role: You will play a central part in running the critical ERP development engine of a global listed company.
- Flexibility: We offer a possibility to hybrid work. Preferred office is Helsinki, but offices also in Turku and Vaasa.
- International environment: Opportunity to work in a diverse, global team and continuously improve ways of working.

Work tasks

Practicalities

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja ESPOO / Kilo

title: Machinist, Bluefors Oy
description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish high-tech company based in Helsinki, working in the field of quantum technology. The company designs and manufactures cryogenic measurement systems used in research and technology development around the world.

As a Machinist at Bluefors, you will manufacture a variety of precision components from materials such as copper, aluminum, brass, stainless steel, and POM plastic. The work is varied and includes producing small batches as well as implementing different machining solutions.

We value a careful and quality-oriented approach, an interest in machining, and a willingness to develop your skills in the role. Previous experience in CNC machining is important, but you do not need to have all the required skills from day one.

Your Responsibilities

As a Machinist, you will work as part of the Bluefors production team, manufacturing components for quantum technology systems. Your responsibilities will include operating and setting up CNC milling machines and manufacturing a variety of components in small batches. You will machine materials such as copper, stainless steel, brass, aluminum, and POM plastic. You will read and interpret technical drawings and machining programs and work accordingly. In addition, you will measure the components you manufacture, inspect their quality, and ensure that they meet the required specifications. You will also contribute to maintaining a clean, organized, and safe working environment and ensuring smooth production.

Requirements

- Previous experience in CNC machining and basic knowledge of machine operation and setup
- Ability to read and work according to technical drawings
- A careful and precise approach to work, with an interest in producing high-quality results
- Willingness to learn new skills and develop as a machinist
- Good teamwork skills and a proactive attitude

We Also Consider the Following an Advantage

- Experience with 5-axis machining and DMG Mori milling machines
- Familiarity with Heidenhain controls
- Experience with Mastercam or other CAM software
- Experience machining copper, brass, or other non-ferrous metals, as well as precision components
- Previous experience in small-batch production or in the technical manufacturing industry

The position is full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, working in a two-shift system. The shift cycle consists of three weeks: two weeks on the day shift (Monday to Friday) and one week on the evening shift (Monday to Thursday, with Fridays off). The evening shift runs from 2:00 PM to midnight.

The selected candidate will initially be employed by Barona Teollisuus Oy on a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of continuing in a longer-term position.

If you are interested in the position and would like to develop your skills as a Machinist as part of the Bluefors production team, submit your application today using the link provided in the job advertisement. We will review applications throughout the recruitment process.

For more information about the position, please contact Ari Kumlander by email at ari.kumlander@barona.fi. Please note that, due to data protection regulations, applications cannot be submitted by email.

title: Lähihoitaja
description:
Työ Tuulensuun palvelukeskuksessa on monipuolista hoitotyötä ikäihmisten ja vammautuneiden parissa. Työhön kuuluu asiakkaiden päivittäinen avustaminen, sairaanhoidolliset tehtävät, voinnin seuranta sekä asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hyvinvoinnin tukeminen.

Onnistuaksesi tässä tehtävässä odotamme sinulta positiivista, asiakaslähtöistä asennetta sekä oma-aloitteista, että vastuuntuntoista työotetta. Osaat nähdä palvelun asiakkaan silmin ja tarjoat laadukasta asiakaspalvelua. Työyhteisön hyvä ilmapiiri on meille tärkeää ja siksi näemme, että hyvät tiimityöskentelytaidot ovat erittäin tärkeässä roolissa.

Edellytämme voimassa olevia lääkelupia (LOVE). Voit myös suorittaa lääkeluvat meidän kautta työsuhteen alussa.

- ateriaetu Tuulensuun Maukkaaseen

- ilmainen kahvi/ tee
