title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned

description:

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Assistant driller
description:
Seeking an assistant driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.

Key Responsibilities:
• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.
• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.
• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.
• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.
• Assisting with cementing.
• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).
• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:
• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.
• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.

Employer can assist with housing.

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.
Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257

title: Lead Game Designer
description:
CCP Games is seeking a Lead Game Designer to help our EVE Online design team grow, align, and deliver impactful gameplay and system as we build EVE into its third decade.

This is primarily a leadership role. While design judgment is essential, your greatest impact will come from mentorship, communication, and enabling designers to do their best work within complex, long-running live systems.

What You'll Do:
Lead, mentor, and support senior designers, with a focus on growth, feedback, and long-term career development
Improve team effectiveness by strengthening communication, collaboration, and clarity across disciplines
Partner with the Game Design Director to evolve and uphold EVE Online’s design process
Guide feature teams through exploration and development, encouraging a solution-oriented mindset while preserving momentum
Foster a culture of empowerment, experimentation, and learning within a live service environment
Identify and address team health issues early, helping teams navigate alignment challenges
Act as a trusted design leader for stakeholders, aligning goals and constraints into shared understanding

What We're Looking For:
6+ years of game design experience, including 2+ years in a people-focused leadership role
Proven ability to mentor and grow experienced designers
Extensive experience with gameplay systems and live game design, with the ability to give high-quality feedback
Clear, empathetic communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills
Experience shipping features in live service, MMO, sandbox, or similarly complex products
A leadership mindset focused on enabling others and team outcomes, not individual ownership
Bonus Experience: Familiarity with EVE Online, sandbox games, or player-driven economies

A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation

title: Verslunarmaður
description:
Nettó Höfn í Hornafirði leitar að starfsfólki í tvö störf við áfyllingu kvöld/nætur. Um er að ræða starf þar sem vinnutími er að jafnaði frá kl. 20:00–04:00, sex daga vikunnar.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.

A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The main duties and responsibilities of the Project Manager are outlined as follows: Work as part of a team in the delivery of one or more projects at any one time, embracing the ethos of a “one team” culture. Ensure Health, Safety, Environmental & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are always adhered to on-site. Instil a positive Health and Safety culture within the team in their thinking and actions. Work closely and collaborate with all key stakeholders including clients, client representatives and third-party agencies. Ensure a positive experience for the client and their representatives instilling an ethos of collaboration and cooperation. Lead and co-ordinate the multi-discipline civil, MEICA and process team in the delivery of the project on-time, on-budget and to the highest quality standards. Facilitate the co-ordination role of the PSDP for live projects with internal and external designers. Represent the company as PSCS on live sites within your remit and co-ordinate all required documentation to be present on-site and up to date. Conduct regular Health and Safety inspections on live sites as well as conducting and leading toolbox talks and white-board meetings. Ensure best practice project management techniques are used such as Lean Construction and Last Planner. Monitor project performance including risk and opportunities. Mitigate/reduce risk where possible and manage opportunities. Report on the monthly performance of your project to the framework manager including performance against programme, budget and HSQE. Lead the team in the procurement of supplies and sub-contracts on time and within budget. Manage cashflow on projects and work with the Contracts Manager/ Commercial Manager to ensure interim payment applications are submitted on-time to the client. Build and promote industry-leading teams by providing training and mentoring of staff including setting out development plans for your team. Provide an active involvement in resource management and recruitment within your team as a hiring manager. Provide assistance, oversight and guidance from time to time on tendering opportunities for new upcoming projects. Respond to and address any client and stakeholder complaints in a timely manner. Obtain client satisfaction surveys and provide any feedback on how to improve our client satisfaction. Seek to improve the project delivery process by providing lessons learned feedback and innovative solutions for adoption on future projects. Keep appraised of the latest standards and technology through continuous professional development (CPD). Other duties as required from time to time. Knowledge, Skills and Experience: The main knowledge, skills and experience required of the Project Manager are outlined as follows: Minimum of 5 years’ experience working in a similar role, preferably in the water and wastewater industry. Extensive working knowledge of the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work (Construction) Regulations

title: Construction - Process Hydraulic Design Engineer - Senior Position
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Main Duties and Responsibilities: Strategic Design Role This role is a technical delivery-focused position, operating with a high degree of autonomy while working under the direction of the Regional Process & Hydraulic Design Lead. The Senior Engineer is responsible for Coordinate and deliver defined packages of work, coordinating with other disciplines, and supporting intermediate level and junior engineers. Develop high-impact design initiatives that enhance project outcomes and organisational capability. Establish and refine consistent, efficient, and high-quality design workflows across all projects. Line Management & Talent Development Mentor, coach, and develop engineers and designers at all levels, enhancing technical capability, decision-making, and leadership skills. Provide effective line management to the design team, including performance management, and design task control. Promote a culture of innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement within the design function. Support coordination of design tasks within the design team, including supporting workload planning, and resource control. Support and collaborate engineers and designers at all levels enhancing technical capability, decision-making and informal mentoring to junior team members. Foster a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture that prioritises technical excellence, professional development and informal mentoring to junior team members. Technical Design, Engineering & Equipment Assessment Oversee and develop detailed technical assessments of process and mechanical equipment, ensuring appropriate specification, performance, and integration into system designs. Manage of technical interfaces across MEICA disciplines, coordinating input from Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Control & Automation teams to produce fully integrated, clash-free design solutions. Work closely with ACC (Advanced Control & Communications) teams to develop intelligent, data-rich P&IDs and ensure accurate control-system integration within the design. Develop and review process and hydraulic calculations across chemical, physical, and biological treatment processes. Produce and review technical deliverables, including: Process & Mechanical Design Reports Concept site Layouts Intelligent P&IDs and PFDs Equipment selection and specifications Whole Life Cost Assessments Hydraulic & process calculations Hydraulic Profiles Energy balances Control philosophies and automation logic inputs Motor & Instrument Lists Constructability Assessments Construction Sequence Narratives Process Impact Plans (PIPs) Interface Registers and Decision Logs Development of efficient, safe, and future-proofed site layouts, ensuring adequate space planning, operability, maintainability, and construction access.

You will also have the opportunity to develop client relationships, lead design discussions, and contribute to integrated, high-quality project delivery across all stages. Main Duties and Responsibilities: Strategic Design Leadership This role is a technical delivery-focused position, operating with a high degree of autonomy while working under the direction of the Head of Process & Hydraulic Engineering. Develop and maintain a coherent design vision aligned with business objectives and long-term strategic goals. Prioritise and lead high-impact design initiatives that enhance project outcomes and organisational capability. Establish and refine consistent, efficient, and high-quality design workflows across all projects. Promote a culture of innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement within the design function. Identify skills gaps and deliver structured development plans to build a high-performing, multidisciplinary team. Foster a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture that prioritises technical excellence and professional development. Technical Design, Engineering & Equipment Assessment

title: Technical Standards Engineer
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The Technical Standards Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and controlling maintenance standards, procedures, and technical documentation that support safe, compliant, and efficient aircraft maintenance operations. Acting as a key link between operational teams, Safety, and Compliance functions, the role ensures that technical requirements are clearly communicated, consistently applied, and effectively managed across the organisation. The position also supports continuous improvement and key organisational change. Responsibilities • Assist in amendments of the organisation’s procedures and manuals (MOE, including the associated procedure(s)) with due consideration of EASA/UKCAA regulatory requirement and any other applicable regulatory requirements. • Responsible for assisting PAML Managers and Supervisors to complete effective root cause and corrective actions in relation to safety occurrences, information security events/vulnerabilities and findings raised as a result of compliance audits or internal reporting scheme output. • Responsible for compliance with and promotion of the Safety Policy and Objectives. • Assist in the timely closure of appropriate group containment and corrective actions because of safety occurrences, audit findings or information security events/vulnerabilities. • Responsible for standardising processes and procedures across all sites within PAML group and the wider Ryanair network. • Responsible for the assessment of alternative tools and management of technical documentation system • Responsible for the assessment of proposed C/S & S/S individuals and composition of the application for company approval to be reviewed and accepted by the Compliance Department. • Responsible for review of OJT applications in accordance with UK/EU Part 66 • Drive Continuous improvement within PAML group and PAML management of change process • Work in accordance with company manuals and procedures, including: - Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE) - Technical Standards Manual (TSM) - Safety Management Manual (SMM) • Navigate and utilize engineering systems including: - Boeing fleet technical documentation systems - Digital technical document libraries - Technical Services Query dashboards • Promote and apply human factors principles throughout all duties Key Skills & Competencies • Strong knowledge of aviation regulatory requirements (EASA/UK CAA Part 145 & Part CAMO) would be a distinct advantage • Attention to detail and high standards of documentation accuracy • Effective communication and problem-solving skills • Ability to work independently and as part of a team • Strong safety mindset and awareness of human factors Experience & Qualifications • Experience in aircraft maintenance or technical support environment • Knowledge of document control/revision in a technical/regulated environment • Familiarity with MyBoeingFleet, Microsoft Office • Knowledge and experience of using AMOS

description:

Job title: Early Years and Afterschool Educator Employer: The Early Years Academy Limited Location: Kill Lane, Kill O' The Grange, Blackrock, Co. Dublin A94 FC44 Annual Salary: €46,053 Weekly Hours: 45.25h Requirements: • Minimum QQI Level 5 in Early Childhood Care & Education (Level 6 or higher preferred) • Knowledge of Aistear, Síolta, and child development best practices • Previous experience in a similar role is an advantage • Strong communication and teamwork skills Duties: • Plan, implement and review play-based learning experiences appropriate to the age group being worked with: guided by Aistear and Síolta in the early years rooms, and by the National Quality Guidelines for School Age Childcare Services in the afterschool service. • Provide warm, responsive care for assigned children, including personal care, mealtimes and rest routines in the early years rooms, and snack, homework support and self-care in the throughout. • Complete observations, learning stories and developmental records for assigned early years children and contribute to individual planning, including AIM support where applicable. • Work in partnership with parents and guardians through daily handovers, updates on progress and attendance at parent meetings, and escalate any concern to the Lead Educator or Manager. • Promote inclusion, positive behaviour and emotional resilience through consistent, respectful guidance and role modelling across both age groups. • Maintain a clean, safe and stimulating environment in both settings, including the setting up, care and packing down of rooms, resources and equipment. • Comply with the Child Care Act 1991 (Early Years Services) Regulations 2016, the Child Care Act 1991 (Early Years Services) (Registration of School Age Services) Regulations 2018, the Children First Act 2015 and all Employer policies and procedures; report any child protection concern immediately to the Designated Liaison Person. • Attend team meetings, mandatory training and continuous professional development, and maintain the qualifications and Garda vetting required to work in the sector.

Good understanding of health, safety, and environmental regulations applicable to automotive paint operations. Competent in paint preparation, masking, sanding, colour matching, spray-paint application, polishing, and quality inspection. Strong advantages - Fanuc control and Cincinnati CNC experience, although equivalent-machine experience is acceptable. - Toolroom, mouldmaking, precision maintenance or one-off component experience. - CNC programming, CAD/CAM, grinding or EDM experience. What TPS offers - 40 paid hours per week. - Earliest start by agreement, subject to notice and work permission; portal start date is indicative. - Starting annual salary: €38,000. - Mainly daytime, with occasional 16:00–00:00 evening work. - TPS can arrange accommodation for as long as reasonably required. Include your current country, nationality/work-right status, notice period, English level, machines and controls used, manual milling and turning experience, CNC setup/programming experience, materials machined and typical tolerances achieved. title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

description:
Hai sempre desiderato lavorare in un settore dinamico e orientato al futuro, contribuendo così alla produzione di energia sostenibile e rinnovabile? Questa è la tua occasione per contribuire a plasmare un futuro verde insieme a Thöni Sustainable Solutions! Da oltre 30 anni realizziamo impianti di biogas in tutto il mondo e siamo leader tecnologici in questo settore. 1 Tecnico_a di messa in servizio Location:

Italia

Type of Employment:

Full time

Your tasks

* Esecuzione autonoma della messa in servizio di impianti di biogas e dei relativi componenti

* Controlli funzionali e di sicurezza di tutti i sistemi in conformità alle norme tecniche

* Regolazione e ottimizzazione dei parametri dell'impianto per un funzionamento conforme al contratto

* Assistenza durante il collaudo tecnico

* Formazione e istruzione del personale operativo in loco

* Documentazione dei lavori eseguiti e verbali di consegna

* Stretta collaborazione con i responsabili di progetto, i tecnici e il team di assistenza

Your profile

* Formazione tecnica completata (ad es. meccatronico, elettrotecnico) o qualifica equivalente

* Esperienza nel settore degli impianti a biogas, degli impianti energetici o delle messe in servizio industriali - almeno 3 anni

* Conoscenze di tecnologia di controllo, regolazione e misurazione

* Disponibilità a viaggiare regolarmente all'estero

* Stile di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e orientato alle soluzioni

* Capacità di lavorare in team, impegno e orientamento al cliente

* Italiano come lingua madre o fluente, buona padronanza del tedesco o dell'inglese

Our offer

In qualità di datore di lavoro attraente, offriamo a persone di talento e motivate incarichi stimolanti e variegati in un contesto internazionale, con opportunità di crescita a lungo termine. In quanto azienda familiare di successo, attribuiamo grande importanza a un clima di rispetto reciproco e a una collaborazione orientata al lavoro di squadra. Inoltre, ci impegniamo attivamente a favore della sostenibilità e della tutela dell'ambiente, implementando processi che preservano le risorse e lavorando costantemente alla riduzione della nostra impronta ecologica.

description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Industrial Design Engineer

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?

Lebens-Qualität am Arbeitsplatz ist Ihnen wichtig?

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens.

Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden.

Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:

Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion
- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien
- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg
- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte
- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen
- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung
- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen
- Mitwirkung bei Design-Reviews sowie Bewertung von Prototypen und Vorserienteilen hinsichtlich Designqualität und Anmutung
- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen
- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE
- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:

Wissen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden
- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen
- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und Fertigungstechnologie

Wollen

- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis
- Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen
- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung
- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Können

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge
- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)
- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
- Die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Designsprache unserer Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten
- Mitarbeit an internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten
- Arbeiten in einem wirtschaftlich stabilen, werteorientierten Familienunternehmen mit echter Wertschätzung
- Offene Kommunikation und ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander
- Langfristige Perspektiven und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

title: CJEVAR/CJEVARICA
description:
Inoxmont-VS d.o.o. / VS PRODUCTION d.o.o., vl. Mladen Vidović, zbog povećanog obima posla i narudžbi, traži sljedeće: Opis posla i odgovornosti:

  • montaža cjevovoda po tehničkom nacrtu izometrije na industrijskim postrojenjima (bijele cijevi od 2-4 mm),
  • samostalno, točno izračunavanje svih segmenata po izometriji
Prednost:
  • iskustvo rada u kemijskim industrijama, termoelektranama, industrije papira i dr.
  • poznavanje tehničkog nacrta – izometrije
Trenutno kombinacija poslova na terenu Njemačka, Italija i proizvodni pogon Sigetec Ludbreški. Iznimno konkurentni uvjeti, plaća ovisi da li je teren ili proizvodnja u HR. Poslodavac osigurava:
  • iznadprosječna primanja i stimulacije za ostvarene rezultate
  • plaćen smještaj
  • organiziran prijevoz službenim vozilom
  • dugoročan i stabilan radni odnos
  • bonusi za inicijative, jubilarne nagrade i darovi, Uskrsnice, Božićnice i bogati dječji darovi
  • stalnu podršku 24/7 od strane tima matične tvrtke Inoxmont-VS

title: TIG ZAVARIVAČ/CJEVAR/MONTER (M/Ž)
description:

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety

- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.

- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: AML Governance Officer (m/f)
description:
AML Governance Officer

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Experienced
Home Office Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

The AML Governance Officer is responsible for strengthening and harmonising AML/CFT governance across our EU entities and branches. Working closely with the Group AML/CTF Office in Switzerland and local Compliance teams, you will support the Group-wide AML/CFT Compliance Function, oversee key AML/CFT risks and regulatory developments, and help ensure consistent and effective compliance across Europe.

What you can expect

• Develop, maintain and continuously enhance the EU AML/CFT Governance Framework, ensuring consistent implementation of policies, standards and controls across EU entities.
• Monitor EU and international AML/CFT regulatory developments, assess their impact and coordinate the implementation of new requirements across the organisation.
• Coordinate and provide oversight of the EU-wide ML/TF Risk Assessment, challenging local assessments and ensuring that identified risks are appropriately addressed.
• Act as a key contact for AMLA and other supervisory authorities, coordinating regulatory requests, inspections, submissions and remediation actions.
• Support the EU AML Compliance Manager and Group AML/CTF Office with governance reporting, regulatory analysis, risk monitoring and preparation of management and committee materials.
• Coordinate with local AML Officers and Compliance teams to promote consistent standards, effective information sharing and best practices across jurisdictions.
• Monitor the effectiveness of the AML/CFT governance framework, identify areas for improvement and support audits, regulatory reviews, remediation programmes and training initiatives.
• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Audit and the business to foster a strong AML/CFT governance and compliance culture.

What we expect

• Master's degree in Law, Compliance, Finance, Risk Management or a related field. An AML certification (ACAMS, ICA or equivalent) is an asset.
• 10+ years of experience in AML/CFT, ideally within insurance, banking or financial services, with international exposure.
• Strong knowledge of the EU AML/CFT regulatory framework, including AMLA requirements, EU AML legislation, FATF standards and EBA guidelines.
• Proven experience working with regulators and supervisory authorities.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational and reporting skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative and adaptable mindset.
• Very good command of English and French, both written and spoken. Any additional language is an asset.

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

title: Information Security Officer (m/f)
description:
Information Security Officer
Information Security - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International
Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role - Are you ready for a challenge?

The Information Security Officer is responsible for the day-to-day infosec tasks, including in relation to risk management, infosec governance, internal and external audit support, access management and monitoring and reporting of infosec events and incidents.

This role is part of our Information Security Department and will be reporting to an Information Security Manager.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Undertake internal security assessments and facilitate the creation of action plans with key business units;
• Perform information security operational tasks and day to day follow up of actions with the overall objective of ensuring the operational effectiveness of existing security controls, improve the overall control environment and reduce risk exposure;
• Assist with the review and maintenance of existing Information Security controls and the design of new ones in line with evolving business, security or legal/regulatory requirements;
• Actively follow-up access rights entitlement reviews and request validations;
• Develop and maintain relationships with business units, to emphasise and promote the importance of Information security, risk and governance management;
• Work with internal and external auditors in relation to information security audits;
• Conduct risk assessment activities and execute risk treatment plans;
• Analyse and support the remediation of information security incidents;

Your profile - Have you got what it takes to become our Information Security Officer?

• Studies or initial experience in a combination of risk management, information security, and IT roles;
• At least 4-5 years of experience in Information Security or IT Security;
• Technical background in the field of security technologies and architectures;
• Knowledge of technological trends and developments in the area of IT and Information Security;
• Good communicator, ownership, problem-solving, solution oriented, service oriented, ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment, team work;
• Understanding of risk assessment and audit processes and techniques, specifically within the domain of financial information security;
• Basic knowledge of network and application security, as well as authentication, identity management and penetration testing technologies;
• Experience with DLP, NAC, SIEM, PAM and intrusion detection software;
• Understanding of advanced security protocols and standards;
• Understanding of software and security architectures and principles of secure network design;
• Have good understanding of anti-virus software, firewalls and similar products;
• Knowledge of generic software development lifecycle processes;
• Fluent English is a must. Any other European language would be considered as an asset.
• Professional certification, such as a CISSP, CISM, CISA or other information security credentials, is an asset;
• Working knowledge of security and control frameworks, such as ISO 27001, CobiT, COSO and ITIL.

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Given the sensitive nature of our business, industry sector and the role as described, the selected candidate is required to provide a criminal record (Bulletin n°3 for Luxembourgish residents). This excerpt will be kept by Utmost Luxembourg S.A. in compliance with article 8-5 (2) of the law of 23 July 2016 and for no longer than one month from the conclusion of the employment contract; otherwise, it will be destroyed without any undue delay should the candidate not be hired.

description:
