title: Biträdande platschef till STF Saltoluokta Fjällstation
description:
Svenska Turistföreningen driver nio fjällstationer

Intill Kungsleden och nationalparkerna Stora Sjöfallet och Sarek ligger STF Saltoluokta Fjällstation. Ända sedan 1912 har människor färdats hit för att uppleva fjällen, maten och den storslagna naturen.

Läs mer om Saltoluokta här.

Livet på en fjällstation är varierande, spännande och lärorikt, precis som en dag på fjället kan vara. Svenska Turistföreningens vision och ditt uppdrag är att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för att få fler att upptäcka Sverige på ett hållbart sätt.

Nu söker vi en biträdande platschef till STF Saltoluokta Fjällstation

Är du en närvarande ledare som brinner för både gäster och medarbetare och gärna hugger i där det behövs? Att jobba på fjällstation är så mycket mer än bara ett jobb, det är en livsstil. Som biträdande platschef är du platschefens närmaste stöd och har en viktig roll i att leda och säkerställa den dagliga driften av anläggningen.

I kombination uppdraget som biträdande platschef kommer du att ha chefsansvar för en av anläggningens avdelningar, utifrån din profil och erfarenhet: Mat & dryck, Boende & reception eller Fastighet & logistik. Du ansvarar för den dagliga driften och utvecklingen inom din avdelning, samtidigt som du tillsammans med platschefen verkar för att hela anläggningen fungerar väl.

Hos oss blir du en del av en sammansvetsad grupp där vi stöttar varandra och ser möjligheter och hjälper till i andra delar på fjällstationen om det behövs. Våra värdeord – omtänksam, nyfiken, äkta, professionell och engagerad – genomsyrar allt vi gör.

Vad innebär rollen som biträdande platschef?

    

Operativt leda och delta i den dagliga driften samt säkerställa att rutiner följs

    

Tillsammans med platschef verkställa verksamhetsplan och budget

    

Ha helhetsperspektiv på anläggningens drift och vara med och prioritera utifrån verksamhetens behov

    

Leda, utveckla och följa upp arbetet inom din avdelning

    

Personalansvar för din avdelning, samt för hela personalgruppen vid platschefs frånvaro

    

Rekrytering, introduktion och utveckling av medarbetare

    

Representera STF och vara en ambassadör för verksamheten

    

I övrigt bidra där verksamheten behöver dig, både på anläggningen och inom STF

Vem är du?

    

Du trivs med att arbeta operativt, nära både gäster och medarbetare

    

Du tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet

    

Du är lösningsorienterad, prestigelös och samarbetar väl med andra

    

Du har goda kunskaper inom svenska och engelska

Vi värdesätter ditt driv, din kommunikationsförmåga och din förmåga att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna till gästmöten i linje med STFs värdeord.

Information om tjänsten

    

Anställningsform: Visstidsanställning 10 månader, med möjlighet till tillsvidareanställning

    

Tjänstegrad enligt överenskommelse; grund är 80% på helår, möjlighet till högre tjänstegrad finns med arbete på andra anläggningar under perioder då Saltoluokta håller stängt.

    

Anställningsstart i början av 2027

    

Arbetstiden följer verksamhetens behov och innebär arbete såväl vardagar som helger, dagtid som kvällstid.

    

Då anläggningen är stängd finns möjlighet att jobba från annan ort.

    

Individuell lön baserad på kompetens och erfarenhet

    

Kostavdrag enligt kollektivavtal, regleras av Skatteverket

Vad erbjuder vi?

    

Att vara en del i organisationen i Norrbotten med många härliga kollegor

    

Personalboende mot hyresavdrag tillsammans med kollegor på fjällstationen

    

En fritid med fjället precis utanför dörren

    

Utvecklingsmöjligheter inom STF

    

Minnen för livet och erfarenhet från besöksnäringen

Rekrytering sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt! Ingen AI, bara människor – engagerad personal sköter hela rekryteringsprocessen.

Har du frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta områdeschef Marit Sarri på e-post marit.sarri@stfturist.se. Facklig kontaktperson för Unionen: Maja Hök, maja.hok@stfturist.se

title: Data Scientist - Anti-cheat
description:
The Anti-cheat team at Embark is responsible for upholding the integrity of our games, identifying instances of unfair play, and protecting the experience of our players. We have a versatile toolbox at our disposal, which we continuously evolve and refine, including client-side protections, third-party systems, machine-learning models. Being a core function supporting all of Embark games, we collaborate with many different stakeholders throughout the organisation, such as game teams, legal and community management.

We are now looking for a well rounded Data scientist to strengthen our operational capacity. As a member of our Anti-cheat team you will, among other things, be responsible for supporting our game teams with investigations into suspicious activities, performance analyses of detection rules, exploration of data and player behavior to design new rules. Your statistical background helps you identify significant patterns, and separate signals from noise. We operate in a complex environment where billions of telemetry events and other data are collected each day from all our games.

You are likely curious to continuously learn new skills. You enjoy working autonomously and taking initiatives, while also collaborating within and across teams. You have a passion for data and technology, and feel excited to use your skills to help protect our players from unfair play and malicious actors. By being creative and experimental you aim to solve problems in a game-changing way.

Example of responsibilities

    

Perform ad-hoc investigations into suspicious patterns and gameplay behavior

    

Work with game teams and customer support to verify and explain rule detections

    

Support our Esport event teams with vetting of contestants

    

Provide reports and performance analyses of our anti-cheat operation

We would love if you have

    

A creative and curious mind.

    

Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with database querying, preferably using tools such as BigQuery

    

Proficiency in Python.

    

Experience working with Google Cloud Platform.

    

Experience working with ETLs and data pipelines.

    

Experience in predictive modeling and analysis over large datasets

    

Professional English communication skills.

    

Experience and/or interest in games and anti-cheat will be considered a bonus!

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

We welcome game makers of all sex, class, colour, age, gender identity, education, religion, opinion, culture, nation of origin, language, sexual orientation, shape, size, and ability.

Did we leave anyone out? Well, we welcome you, too! We think that the gaming industry is made better when everyone has a seat at the table.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

title: Driftchef inom konferens, reception & lokalvård
description:
Vill du leda engagerade team, utveckla affären och driva en unik konferensverksamhet i hjärtat av Göteborg? Sodexo söker nu en säljande och resultatinriktad Driftchef som vill vara med i en spännande fas för en av våra mest centrala anläggningar. Som Driftchef ansvarar du för helheten inom konferens, reception och lokalvård på vår konferensanläggning i centrala Göteborg samt ytterligare två enheter i regionen. Du blir en nyckelperson i att säkerställa hög service, motiverade team och en affär som växer och utvecklas.

Detta är en roll för dig som trivs i korsningen mellan ledarskap, affärsutveckling och daglig drift. Du får en bred och varierad vardag där du både arbetar nära kunder och gäster, driver försäljning av konferensutrymmen – och samtidigt leder med omtanke och tydlighet i Sodexos anda.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

    Driva affärer mot både offentliga och kommersiella kunder.
    Hantera offert- och anbudsprocesser, inklusive upphandlingar via offentliga system.
    Skapa och utveckla starka relationer med externa partners.
    Säkerställa hög service och effektiv drift inom konferens, reception och städ.
    Arbeta nära verksamheten och driften samt planera resurser och rätt bemanning över enheterna.
    Följa upp resultat, ekonomi och kvalitet i verksamheten.
    Leda och utveckla medarbetare på tre enheter.
    Agera coachande och närvarande chef med fokus på trivsel, utveckling och delaktighet.

Vem söker vi?

Du som lyckas i rollen har ett genuint intresse för både ledarskap och affärsutveckling. Du är trygg i att driva sälj, bygga relationer och skapa lönsamhet – samtidigt som du är lyhörd, omtänksam och prestigelös i ledarskapet.

Du behöver ha:

    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av konferens-, event- eller servicebranschen.
    Erfarenhet av försäljning och att driva affärer.
    Ledarerfarenhet med ansvar för personal.
    God systemvana, gärna inom bokning, anbud och schemaläggning.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet inom städ och/eller Facility Management.

Personliga egenskaper som passar i rollen:

    Omtänksam och empatisk – du bygger förtroende och relationer.
    Beslutsam och självgående – du vågar ta ansvar och driva framåt.
    Snabblärd och nyfiken – du sätter dig snabbt in i både verksamhet och affärer.
    Resultatfokuserad – du trivs med att jobba mot mål och ser till att leverera.

Vad vi erbjuder:

Utöver en spännande tjänst och härliga kollegor erbjuder vi dig bland annat: 

    Flexibel och dynamisk arbetsmiljö 
    Tillgång till löpande utbildning och utvecklingsprogram 
    Möjligheter att växa inom företaget
    Stort fokus på hälsa och säkerhet  
    Volontärarbete på betald arbetstid 

Om tjänsten:

Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning på 6 månader. Arbetstiderna är dagtid, veckodagar.

Frågor om tjänsten och rekryteringsprocessen besvaras av Erik Gund på erik.gund@sodexo.com. Observera att vi endast tar emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem. Din ansökan vill vi ha senast 11 oktober 2026.

För denna tjänst kommer vi att genomföra bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samarbete med en extern leverantör. Slutkandidaten kommer att informeras och efterfrågas om medgivande innan det att bakgrundskontrollen genomförs. Observera även att alla medarbetare inom Sodexo ska ha genomgått en identitetsvalidering innan anställning.  

Mer om Sodexo och vilka vi är:

    https://se.sodexo.com/om-oss-1.html
    https://se.sodexo.com/jobba-hos-oss/Mitt-Sodexo/medarbetarsidorna-mitt-sodexo

Redo att vara en del av något större? Ansök idag! 

Sodexokoncernen

Sodexo grundades av Pierre Bellon i Marseille 1966 och är ledande inom mat- och servicetjänster för bättre vardagsupplevelser inom lärande, arbete, hälsa och nöje. Sodexokoncernen är unik genom sitt oberoende och grundarfamiljens delägande, samt sin hållbara affärsmodell. Med sitt utbud av tjänster möter Sodexo vardagens utmaningar med ett dubbelt mål: att förbättra livskvaliteten för våra medarbetare och alla som tar del av vår service, samt att bidra till ekonomiska, sociala och miljömässiga framsteg i de samhällen där vi är verksamma. För oss går tillväxt och socialt engagemang hand i hand. Vårt syfte är att skapa en bättre vardag, för ett bättre liv för alla. Sodexo är medlem i CAC Next 20, Bloomberg France 40, CAC SBT 1.5, FTSE 4 Good och DJSI Index.

title: Fullstack Engineer - Live Platform
description:
As a Fullstack Engineer at Embark, you will be a Gamemaker in a technical team that builds and maintains internal tools that empower our game teams and improve the studio’s efficiency. Your role will directly support game development by creating solutions that automates and streamlines workflows, and provides valuable analytics. You will also be contributing to commercial projects like tools for monetization and customer support.

The team’s goal is to deliver scalable, user-friendly, and cost-efficient solutions that help our teams create dynamic and engaging player experiences. You’ll collaborate closely with game teams, data teams, and the commercial team, reporting to the Tech Lead in Commercial Tech.

As an integral part of a creative and autonomous team, you’ll contribute to high-quality tools and systems for both developers and players. For the frontend we use technologies like React, TypeScript and NextJS. For the backend we use Go, protobuf, Python, and OpenAPI.

Example of responsibilities


    Develop and improve internal tools for game teams and studio-wide use.
    Automate workflows to reduce manual effort and enhance efficiency.
    Build personalized store recommendation systems and tools.
    Continuously refine engineering practices to ensure services are easy to deploy, scale, and maintain.
    Collaborate with multiple teams to deliver tools and solutions that improve both developer and player experiences.

We would love if you have


    A creative and curious mind
    Solid experience with React, TypeScript, NextJS, Go, Python and the GCP stack.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Role Summary

Join Global Finance Operations and help secure reliable accounting and reporting for Scania's production and logistics operations. Our Production and Logistics Accounting and Reporting team is responsible for record-to-report activities for 18 units and is supporting the transition from Oracle to SAP S/4HANA.

As Senior Accountant, you will own the accounting and reporting for one Swedish legal entity within Production and Logistics. You will combine hands-on accounting with stakeholder coordination and continuous improvement. You are not expected to know every Scania process from day one, but we expect you to take ownership, build the necessary business knowledge and resolve deviations in a structured way.

Job responsibiities

•        Own the monthly, quarterly and annual accounting close and reporting for the designated Swedish legal entity, ensuring complete, accurate and timely reporting.

•        Ensure compliance with IFRS, Group requirements and applicable Swedish statutory accounting requirements, coordinating with Tax specialists on relevant tax matters.

•        Ensure that balance sheet reconciliations, key financial controls and supporting documentation are completed, reviewed and followed up, with differences and control exceptions resolved on time.

•        Secure accounting quality across general accounting and reporting, fixed assets, overhead and cost-center accounting, and project accounting, in cooperation with the responsible process teams.

•        Act as the primary accounting contact for the legal entity, working with auditors, Group Reporting, Tax specialists and relevant finance and business control teams.

•        Coordinate accounting interfaces, including payroll and personnel-related postings, and ensure that exceptional transactions follow established approval and control procedures.

•        Analyze accounting deviations, identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions and process improvements with the responsible process owners.

•        Represent accounting and legal-entity requirements in the Oracle-to-SAP S/4HANA transformation, including testing, data validation, cutover and process implementation.

•        Share accounting knowledge and provide technical guidance to colleagues and process teams when required.



Who You Are

You demonstrate strong accounting knowledge, ownership and sound judgment. You have substantial experience with end-to-end accounting and reporting for a Swedish legal entity, including closing, balance sheet control, statutory reporting and coordination with tax and audit specialists. You understand the business impact of accounting issues, communicate them clearly and proactively raise risks and deviations. You share knowledge and challenge unclear ways of working respectfully.

You Need to Bring

•        A university degree in accounting or finance, or an equivalent professional qualification.

•        At least seven years of relevant experience in accounting and financial reporting, including responsibility for a Swedish legal entity.

•        Strong knowledge of Swedish GAAP and statutory requirements, together with practical experience of IFRS and group reporting.

•        Proven experience of independently coordinating monthly, quarterly and annual closing, including balance sheet reconciliations, statutory reporting and audit support.

•        Hands-on experience with a major ERP system, such as Oracle or SAP.

•        Clear and confident communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

We Also Value That You

•        Communicate accounting matters clearly and build effective working relationships across functions.

•        Work calmly and methodically under time pressure, prioritizing issues according to risk, materiality and deadlines.

•        Take a constructive and service-minded approach while safeguarding accounting quality and compliance.

•        Identify root causes, solve problems and turn practical improvements into more efficient and standardized ways of working.

•        Is curiosity about how AI and digital tools can support accounting, reporting and analysis.

It Is an Advantage If You Have

•        Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation, testing or transformation.

•        Experience using data, automation or AI tools to improve accounting and reporting.



This Is Us

You will join a team of 10 skilled and experienced colleagues who value collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

At Scania, we believe embracing AI is essential for our continued growth and innovation. We are committed to providing our employees with the latest AI tools and fostering an environment where AI skills are encouraged. You don't need prior experience with AI - but we expect curiosity, openness and a positive attitude toward learning and applying AI in your role.

We work closely with local finance departments, finance managers, business control teams, Global Process Owners, Subject Matter Experts and other specialists across Global Finance Operations.

Together, we support each other, challenge existing ways of working and contribute to Scania's finance transformation.





Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.



Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-08. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.



If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Hiring Manager: claes.back.ahlstrom@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

title: French-speaking babysitter (Part-Time) – Stockholm
description:

Our assignments

Upgrades offers French language focused childcare in several different forms, ranging from occasional help to spending many hours with the family and becoming like an additional family member.

Each session is a minimum of 2.5 hours and you can combine several assignments to increase your total working hours per week.

Some of our assignments require a clean driving licence, so please state this in your application.

Your profile

As a babysitter at Upgrades, you are warm, responsible, and genuinely enjoy working with children. You are playful, dedicated, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative. You also bring creative ideas for incorporating French into play and everyday interactions, supporting children’s language development in a natural way.

Requirements

    Native-level or full professional proficiency in French
    Excellent sense of responsibility and child safety
    Strong social and interpersonal skills
    Genuinely interested in childcare and pedagogy

About Upgrades

Upgrades offers tailored language lessons, language camps and language-focused childcare. We combine standard babysitting with a strong focus on language development. Visit our website to learn more: www.upgrades.se

title: Experienced Software Developer
description:
Build secure, scalable software as a consultant across defense, automotive, and telecom. Whether your strength is .NET, C++, applications, or Azure, we’d like to hear from you.

Your assignments will vary in technology, scope, and working setup. Depending on the project, you may work at a client’s site, from a Knowit office, or remotely. The solutions range from consumer products to complex industrial systems, giving you opportunities to apply your experience across different technical domains.

You might build scalable backend services in C# and .NET, develop applications, work with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, or solve challenges closer to industrial systems. Some assignments involve environments with high security requirements, including the defense industry.

Collaboration and knowledge sharing are central to the role. You will work alongside colleagues and clients, take responsibility for your delivery, and contribute ideas throughout the development process. As your interests and expertise evolve, you can explore new technologies and develop in a direction that makes sense for you.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

You are an experienced software developer with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

    

Software development in C# and .NET.

    

Development in C++.

    

Backend or application development.

    

Cloud platforms, preferably Azure and the Microsoft ecosystem.

    

Testing at the unit, integration, or system level.

    

Development in environments with high security requirements, such as the defense industry.

We do not expect you to match every item. What matters is that you can contribute solid development experience, enjoy working with others, and take responsibility for your work. Curiosity and a willingness to keep learning will help you thrive as technologies, assignments, and customer needs evolve.

What can you expect from us?

Professional development is part of everyday work. In addition to courses and formal training, you will build knowledge through collaboration, workshops, seminars, and conversations with colleagues from different technical backgrounds.

Close dialogue with your manager helps shape assignments that support your experience, interests, and continued growth. You will have room to explore new technologies, share ideas, and influence how we work.

You will join an inclusive workplace that values openness, community, and continuous improvement. We also recognize the importance of a healthy balance between work and personal life. Workshops, seminars, after-work gatherings, and other shared activities provide opportunities to connect both professionally and socially.

Application

Does this sound like a place where your experience and curiosity could make a difference? Send us your application and tell us which areas of software development interest you most. We look forward to learning more about you.

About Knowit

Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.

Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.

We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

title: Data Protection Specialist
description:
Every day, our work supports people who rely on our products and services to move forward with confidence.

As we build more direct and meaningful ways to engage with patients and consumers - through patient support programs, digital platforms, marketing activities and CRM solutions - protecting their privacy is not just a legal requirement. It is part of the trust we earn, and the value we create.

We are looking for an experienced Data Protection Specialist to join our Global Privacy & Compliance Team and help shape privacy practices that enable responsible, scalable patient and consumer engagement across our markets. In this role, you will help embed privacy into new and evolving initiatives, making it easier for teams to innovate while keeping patients’ and consumers’ rights, expectations and trust at the centre of what we do.

What you will do

    Provide practical legal advice on data protection and privacy, including GDPR and local legislation across our markets
    Advise on privacy requirements throughout the lifecycle of patient and consumer programs across multiple countries
    Draft and review privacy notices, consent language and data processing agreements, and advise on consent and preference management across the data lifecycle
    Develop proportionate privacy policies, procedures and governance, working with local experts and stakeholders to support a consistent global direction
    Monitor regulatory developments and advise on cross-border processing and international data transfers
    Contribute to broader priorities of the Global Privacy & Compliance Team, including relevant training and awareness activities

What do you need to be successful?

Must-have

    A law degree and at least 5 years of relevant legal experience, including substantial work with privacy and data protection
    Strong knowledge of GDPR and related European privacy requirements
    Experience advising on privacy and data protection matters involving direct engagement with patients, consumers or customers
    Excellent communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders across functions and markets
    Full professional proficiency in English
    A practical, self-motivated and independent working style, with the ability to create structure and move things forward in an evolving environment

Nice-to-have

    Experience in medical devices, healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry
    Experience supporting patient engagement, marketing, CRM, consent management or other direct-to-consumer initiatives, preferably across multiple countries
    Experience applying privacy by design to digital products or platforms; familiarity with website tracking technologies, Salesforce, advertising platforms or marketing technology is an advantage

Working model and location

This role is open to candidates located in Denmark or Sweden. We are open to a fully remote working setup, with the possibility of a hybrid model for candidates based near our offices in Copenhagen or Stockholm.

What we offer

We want you to feel supported, trusted and able to do your best work, wherever you are based.

As part of our team, you can expect a competitive local benefits package, which may include:

    Time to recharge - paid vacation and additional leave arrangements in line with local market practices.
    Financial and health-related benefits - including pension arrangements and relevant wellbeing or healthcare-related support, depending on your location.
    Everyday support and perks - such as access to benefit platforms, employee discounts, work equipment and other locally relevant initiatives.
    A flexible, international work environment - collaboration with colleagues across markets, with a working model designed to support both focus and connection.

Join us in our mission to improve people’s mobility so they can live their Life Without Limitations!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.

As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place.

Ready for your next chapter? We are now on the lookout for a platform-focused Senior Data Engineer to join the team in Stockholm.

About the Team

The Data Engineering team is responsible for empowering Storytel with data. We drive the full data lifecycle, from ingestion to delivery, and help ensure that the rest of the business have the data, tools and engineering collaboration needed to help make informed data-driven decisions. As a team, we provide cross-functional competencies in data engineering as well as analytics engineering to the rest of Storytel.

Some of the tech stack and tools we work with are dbt (SQL), Looker, BigQuery, Python, Airflow, Terraform, CI/CD, Github, Airbyte as well as other products included within the Google Cloud Platform. Moreover, we like to keep our skills up to date by frequently engaging lab days.

About the Role

As a Data Engineer, your main responsibility will be to enable the team and the rest of the organization with a data platform and the tools that power data at Storytel. You will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to experiment with new technologies and solutions. Our team is highly collaborative and works in a cross-functional organizational landscape with the following:

Example of responsibilities

    Build core infrastructure: Contribute to building a large-scale, highly performant self-service data platform using cutting-edge technologies
    Innovate and improve: Drive internal tooling and process development to continuously increase data quality and constantly improve the engineering experience.
    Excellence in data management: Continuously improve on building capabilities for effective data utilization across Storytel.
    Collaboration: Collaborate with other engineers, data analysts, data scientists, and decision-makers to understand needs and build self-service.

About you

To be a fit for our team, we believe that you:

    Have a few years of hands-on experience in delivering data products and know the value of accurate consistent data infrastructure.
    Have experience in delivering infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Github (Github actions), and maintaining data orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, Airbyte.
    Have experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and data warehousing (preferably BigQuery).
    Have a good understanding of data access, storage, and optimization.
    Are able to break down and explain complicated technical solutions independent of stakeholders.
    Thrive in an environment focusing on innovation and collaboration and continuously work on personal development.

title: Senior ASIC Verification Engineer
description:
Company Description

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services. We are devoted experts in industry, energy and infrastructure sectors, creating impact for generations to come. AFRY has Nordic roots with a global reach.
Our shared principles - Results driven, Client Centric, Empowering and Accountable - guide us in how we work, grow and succeed together. Join us and unlock transitions towards a sustainable and resilient society.

Job Description

AFRY is establishing a new ASIC Verification team delivery at Ericsson, and we are looking for a Senior ASIC Verification Engineer to play a key role in this journey.
Initially, the role is strongly hands-on, where you will contribute directly to advanced ASIC verification work within Ericsson’s hardware development organization. As the assignment progresses, you will also take part in interviewing and growing the team, acting as a technical ambassador for AFRY and helping shape a high-performing verification organization.
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep technical work with team-building and leadership influence, while working at the forefront of telecom ASIC development.

Qualifications

In this role, you will:
Hands-on ASIC Verification
Develop verification test-benches from scratch for ASIC and SoC designs
Develop tests from scratch using SystemVerilog and UVM
Update and maintain existing tests for evolving designs
Develop test-bench components from scratch (drivers, monitors, scoreboards, sequences)
Update and extend existing test-bench components
Develop Verification IPs (VIPs) from scratch
Maintain and enhance existing VIPs
Integrate third-party VIPs into the verification environment
Implement SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)
Implement functional and code coverage
Analyze coverage results, identify gaps, and create tests to achieve coverage closure

Team & Delivery Responsibilities
Act as an AFRY representative at Ericsson, building strong collaboration with stakeholders
Participate in technical interviews and candidate evaluations
Support team growth and onboarding as the delivery expands
Contribute to defining best practices, verification flows, and ways of working
Support AFRY’s long-term partnership and delivery excellence at Ericsson

Required Skills & Qualifications
Senior-level experience in ASIC/SoC verification
Strong expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM
Proven experience with:

Test and test-bench development from scratch
VIP development and integration
Assertions and coverage-driven verification

Solid understanding of digital design and verification methodologies
Experience working in Linux-based development environments
Strong communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional, multi-company teams

Meriting Experience
Verification of telecom, networking, or high-speed interface ASICs
Experience with coverage analysis and verification metrics
Familiarity with regression flows and CI environments
Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to team ramp-up
Background working in large R&D organizations such as Ericsson

Additional Information

What AFRY Offers

A key role in building a new ASIC Verification team delivery at Ericsson
Combination of deep technical work and team influence
Long-term assignment with growth opportunities
Competitive compensation and benefits
Opportunity to shape the future of telecom and silicon verification.

Apply today and be part of our dynamic team!

Welcome to submit your application, the deadline is 2026-10-31

Contact person for questions: Johan Appelqvist, Group Manager
johan.appelqvist@afry.com

We kindly ask not to be contacted by staffing and recruitment agencies or salespeople offering additional job advertisements.

At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

title: Field Application Scientist
description:
Rarity Bioscience is growing rapidly, with demand for our products higher than ever. To meet this momentum, we are looking for an Field Application Scientist to join our commercial team. This role offers an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and collaborative scale-up environment where science and innovation are at the heart of everything we do.

About The Role

You will act as the scientific ambassador for our company, empowering researchers and lab professionals to unlock the full potential of our superRCA technology. You will will be key in ensuring customer success, from delivering hands-on training, offering expert guidance, and providing professional technical support.You’ll also collaborate closely with R&D and product management to ensure that real-world customer feedback is translated into meaningful product improvements.

Key Responsibilities:

    

Support customer onboarding and provide technical training on our assays and technologies.

    

Act as the primary technical contact for customers, ensuring a smooth implementation and ongoing support.

    

Collaborate closely with R&D to channel customer feedback into product improvements and innovation.

    

Contribute to sales by demonstrating product value, supporting technical evaluations, and participating in customer meetings.

    

Help build scalable workflows, documentation, and best practices for customer success.

The role is based at our office in Uppsala Science Park, soon in Uppsala Business Park as we are moving, but will require frequent global traveling. You will report to the Sales Director and become part of a growing commercial team.

Calling this opportunity a life-changing journey might be too much, but we can definitely promise dedicated colleagues, an open work culture where collaboration is prioritized in everyday work.

Your Profile

We are looking for you who is not only technically proficient and customer-focused but also driven by a passion for empowering others. You'll be the expert guiding scientists, helping them excel in their research by serving as their trusted advisor and application coach.

Essential Qualifications:

    

MSc or PhD degree in Molecular biology, Biotechnology or related scientific field.

    

Scientifically proficient in Molecular techniques such as; RCA, PCR and Flow cytometry.

    

Previous experience from technical support and/or application science roles in an industry setting is essential.

    

Strong communication and presentation skills. Commercial mindset with a willingness to support sales activities.

    

Proactive, structured, and comfortable working independently as well as in cross-functional teams.

    

Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Why Join Us?

At Rarity Bioscience, we believe in fostering a vibrant and collaborative work environment. We have co-located all functions in a modern office in Uppsala Science Park and we regularly organize team get-togethers and off-site events to strengthen our bonds and celebrate our successes.

Please do not hesitate to reach out to Sandra Bydell Sveder, Senior Recruitment Consultant at SallyQ with questions or to get more input why joining, (sandra.sveder@sallyq.se, 0763199688).

Apply now and become a part of our mission to enable efficinet mutation detection and improve patient outcomes worldwide.

title: Nordic Key Account Manager - Wastewater
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

About the job

Ready to make a positive impact? This is a role where you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and strengthening long-term partnerships with some of Alfa Laval's most important customers, as well as finding new opportunities with potential customers in the Nordics. You will act as our go-to person and key enabler within municipal wastewater, while also covering a selected portfolio of strategic industrial wastewater customers across the Nordic region.

The Nordic wastewater market requires dedicated ownership to strengthen customer intimacy, rebuild installed-base position, and drive both Capital Sales and Aftersales growth. You will own relationships with utilities, consultants, integrators, and selected industrial customers across the Nordics, coordinate testing activities, and drive market development.

Your primary focus will be:

    Conduct market and customer analysis and mapping to define business potential and opportunities.
    Analyze accounts and define sales strategy, including relationship management (whom to build which relationship with and why).
    Develop a 2-4 year KAM plan by segmenting customers and prioritizing.
- Develop, implement, and follow up on local sales activities for/with relevant key account(s) or markets to meet growth targets and goals.
- Plan which customer contacts should be involved, how and when, in order to move sales forward efficiently.
- Plan and execute systematic follow-up on all relevant steps in the KAM sales process to ensure that we capture all possible business.
    Proactively connect and coordinate internally with BUs and other sales managers to secure aligned customer and/or market strategies.

Success in this role requires excellent relationship-building skills combined with analytical and technical skills and, of course, a desire to win business!
You understand the importance of being visible and staying close to clients; business travel is a part of the role, approximately 60 days/year, in addition to customer visits close to your home location.

You will be part of a team of five and report to Søren Johansen, a trust-based and empowering leader who leads with clear expectations, open dialogue, and regular commercial sparring. We offer you a role where you will be given significant autonomy and accountability, supported by constructive feedback, development opportunities, and help navigating complex customer and organizational challenges.

Who are you

You actively engage and network with stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate customer needs into opportunities. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across functions and cultures. Most importantly, you are motivated by developing strategic partnerships and delivering sustainable business growth.

What you know

We are looking for someone with experience in a similar role, who has the ability to learn and understand technical solutions and connect them to customer value, as well as being able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions and countries.

Requirements:

    A few years of relevant experience in wastewater, technical B2B sales, key account management, or business development.
    Wastewater expertise and experience with consultancies, integrators, or contractors.
    Strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.
    Practical CRM experience.
    Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, environmental technology, water technology, chemistry, business, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent industry experience and documented commercial results may substitute for formal education.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, in addition to a Nordic language.
    Driving licence.

Merit:

    Experience with sludge treatment, dewatering, separation technologies, public tenders, and/or municipal procurement.

We are conducting a continuous review of received applications. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Please send your application no later than October 14th, 2026.
We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!

At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in or have an established presence in Søborg/Kolding (Denmark), Lund (Sweden), Sandvika/Oslo (Norway), or Espoo (Finland).

Our commitment to integrity

We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit for a role. To help us achieve this, we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application, you will be invited to play the assessment games.

As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre-employment process.

title: Senior Rock Engineer
description:
Looking to shape the future of underground mining? Join us and help drive long-term mine development while contributing to the next generation of mining levels in Kiruna Mine

The sustainable transformation starts with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transition to a sustainable future. Just as we aim to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally. Do you want to help lay the foundation for the way we live and the world we build around us?

Your role

As a Rock Engineer, you will play a vital role in ensuring safe and reliable mining operations while supporting the long-term development of Kiruna Mine. You will work closely with mine planners, geologists, rock mechanics specialists, and other technical experts to provide geotechnical expertise for both current operations and future mine expansion projects. A significant part of the role involves contributing to prefeasibility studies for mining below the current main haulage level and helping to shape the future of underground mining.

in this role, you will:

    Develop and review mine layouts, ground support strategies, and geotechnical designs.
    Collaborate on mine sequencing to ensure safe and reliable production.
    Provide rock mechanics expertise to Life of Mine planning and future mine development studies.
    Assess geotechnical risks, support mine design, and evaluate monitoring and instrumentation needs.
    Deliver operational rock mechanics support through inspections, seismic monitoring, rehabilitation planning, and damage mapping.

In this position, you will combine hands-on operational support with long-term strategic development, helping shape the future of underground mining in Kiruna.

What you bring

We are looking for someone who is confident in their role, with strong analytical skills and a collaborative approach to solving complex challenges in rock mechanics and underground mining. You are an engaged and communicative team player who listens actively to others and thrives in a dynamic environment where safety, innovation, and continuous improvement are central to success.

Requirements

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant engineering or geoscience discipline.
    Experience working in underground mining environments.
    Experience from underground caving operations or similar mining methods.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
    Valid B driver's license.

Meritorious

    Experience in seismic analysis.
    Experience with numerical modelling.
    Experience in project management.
    Knowledge of Swedish.

Warm welcome with your application!

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we typically do not ask for cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your competence and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Applications are reviewed continuously, so please do not wait to submit your application.

Start: Soon as possible.

Location: Kiruna

Employment type: Full-time, daytime.

LKAB är en internationell gruv- och mineralkoncern med norra Sverige som bas och hela världen som arbetsplats. title: Web Manager I Brand, Marketing and Communications | Stockholm
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla en av världens starkaste professionella tjänsteorganisationers digitala närvaro? Som Web Manager får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla EY:s digitala närvaro i Sverige samtidigt som du bidrar till att forma framtiden för vårt nordiska webbteam. Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett operativt driv med ett intresse för att leda förändring, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa resultat tillsammans med andra.





Möjligheten



Som Web Manager med placering i Sverige har du huvudansvaret för den svenska delen av ey.com och är samtidigt en del av vårt nordiska webbteam. Du kommer också att få möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, prioriteringar och utvecklingen inom det nordiska webbteamet, med potential att successivt ta en mer ledande roll över tid.



Du blir en del av ett engagerat nordiskt BMC-nätverk (Brand, Marketing & Communications) och samarbetar med kollegor över både lands- och verksamhetsgränser. Här får du möjlighet att dela idéer, utvecklas i din roll och bidra till initiativ som gör skillnad.

Som Web Manager spelar du en nyckelroll i att utveckla EY:s digitala närvaro i Sverige. Du kombinerar strategi, innehåll och analys för att skapa relevanta och engagerande webbupplevelser, samtidigt som du samarbetar med kollegor över Norden och globalt för att driva webbplatsen framåt.     Ha det övergripande ansvaret för den svenska delen av ey.com.
    Utveckla innehåll och användarresor som stärker varumärket och skapar värde för våra målgrupper.
    Arbeta datadrivet med analys, SEO, konverteringsoptimering och kontinuerliga förbättringar.
    Bidra till nordiska och globala webbinitiativ, projekt och utvecklingsinsatser.
    Bygga starka samarbeten med marknads-, kommunikations- och verksamhetsteam för att säkerställa en sammanhållen digital upplevelse.





Färdigheter och egenskaper för framgång



För att trivas och lyckas i rollen kombinerar du digital kompetens med ett starkt affärs- och användarfokus. Du gillar att ta ansvar, samarbeta med olika intressenter och driva förbättringar som ger resultat.





Kvalifikationer



    Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom digital kommunikation, webb, marknadsföring eller liknande område, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet av arbete med webbplattformar, digitalt innehåll eller digital användarupplevelser
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i ett innehållshanteringssystem (CMS)
    Erfarenhet av webbanalys och datadriven optimering
    Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
    Förmåga att samarbeta med olika intressenter och driva arbete framåt





Meriterande



    Erfarenhet av Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
    Kunskap inom SEO, användarupplevelse och konverteringsoptimering
    Erfarenhet från en större eller internationell organisation likt vår
    Erfarenhet av innehållsstrategi och digitala kundresor





Som person är du



    Initiativtagande och drivande: du vågar utmana befintliga arbetssätt och driva förändring
    Strukturerad med god känsla för kvalitet
    Samarbetsorienterad och relationsskapande där du engagerar människor
    Lösningsorienterad och nyfiken på digital utveckling





Vad vi erbjuder dig



På EY kommer vi att hjälpa dig utveckla och anpassa dina färdigheter framåt utifrån en upplevelse i världsklass. Vi stärker dig i en flexibel miljö och låter dig och din kompentens blomma i en kultur som värdesätter mångfald och inkludering på en global nivå. Läs mer här.





Är du redo att “Shape your future with confidence”? Ansök idag.



Då är du varmt välkommen att söka tjänsten. Skicka in din ansökan senast den den 18e oktober 2026. Vid frågor om tjänsten kontaktar du Nicoline Sundt på Nicoline.sundt@no.ey.com. Vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontaktar Simon Aspler på simon.aspler@se.ey.com. Vi accepterar inte ansökningar eller intresseanmälningar via email.



Observera att en bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.



På EY värdesätter vi mångfald och uppmuntrar ansökningar från individer från olika bakgrunder. Om du har frågor, behöver stöd, eller anpassning av rekryteringsprocessen på grund av en funktionsnedsättning, tveka inte på att kontakta oss på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. Vi finns här för att stötta dig.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Sales Development Representative - SE, DK & NO
description:
Help Global Brands Get Discovered Online 📍

Are you energetic, competitive, and ready to take the next big step in your career?

PinMeTo is a fast-growing tech company helping global brands (like H&M, 7-Eleven, and Hertz) connect their physical stores with the digital world. We’re looking for a hungry Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our HQ in Malmö.

Whether this is your first real step into B2B tech or your second job in sales, this is your entry ticket into modern SaaS sales. You don't need a master's degree in business, we value drive, grit, and the willingness to learn above all else!

Your Role

Based at our HQ in Malmö, you’ll be on the frontlines helping us expand our reach across Sweden, Denmark, and Norway.

    

Connect with Decision-Makers: Reach out to prospective clients via phone, email, and LinkedIn to spark curiosity about PinMeTo.

    

Book High-Value Meetings: Qualify leads and schedule meetings for our senior sales team (Account Executives).

    

Research & Target: Identify exciting multi-location brands and map out key contacts in your target markets.

    

Learn from the Best: Get continuous coaching and training through our internal Sales Academy to build your sales toolkit.

Who Are You?

    

Fluent Swedish: You will lead professional business conversations in Swedish.

    

Strong English: You’re confident collaborating in English with international colleagues and clients.

    

Hungry & Self-Motivated: You have high energy, a strong work ethic, and a winning mindset.

    

Background in Sales: Experience in phone sales (B2C), telemarketing, telecom, or insurance sales is a huge plus! You know how to pick up the phone and handle objections.

    

Resilience: You don't get discouraged by a "no", you see it as just a stepping stone to the next "yes".

    

Bonus points: Fluent or proficient in Danish or Norwegian, as you will also be reaching out to prospective clients in these markets.

Why Start Your Career at PinMeTo?

🚀 Build a Solid Foundation: You’ll gain hands-on experience in B2B SaaS sales, mastering tools and methodologies that will set you up for long-term success in the tech industry.

📚 Continuous Learning: We invest in your personal development with hands-on coaching, clear feedback, and training through our internal Sales Academy.

🌍 Great HQ in Malmö: Work alongside ambitious, international colleagues in an open, high-energy environment.

🍕 Fun Culture: We celebrate wins together, support each other, organize team activities, and make sure work is something you look forward to every day.

Hiring Process
    

Intro Call: A quick video meeting to get to know each other.

    

Onsite Interview: Meet the team at our Malmö HQ and get a feel for the workplace.

    

Offer: Welcome aboard! ⭐️

Ready to kickstart your career in tech sales? Send us your CV in English today, we interview candidates continuously! 🧡

PinMeTo was founded in 2013, when location data of most companies was outdated, inconsistent or simply missing on services like Google, Facebook and Apple. The vision was to provide a solution that enables brands with multiple locations to connect with their customers, outperform their competitors and thrive. Since then we have grown to 100+ employees located in 8 countries, helping 1,000+ companies manage 125,000+ locations worldwide. Trusted by enterprise companies like H&M, 7-Eleven, and Hertz, PinMeTo stands as a leading player within the local search and marketing technology industry.

title: Director Corporate Affairs, Circular Economy, Nature and Packaging Policy
description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Director Corporate Affairs – Circular Economy, Nature and Packaging Policy, for a strategic advisor role to lead policy stakeholder engagement and strategic partnerships in this area and to develop and drive development and deployment of the global Tetra Pak policy toolbox related to circular economy, nature and packaging policies.

In this role you will be part of the global Corporate Affairs team working closely with our Packaging Solutions business unit, our Corporate Affairs markets team of 20+ professionals as well as in our Sustainability and Communications teams and other business units. As Director Corporate Affairs – Circular Economy, Nature and Packaging policy, you will report to the Vice President Corporate Affairs and you will have a team of two collaborating with you in the internal and external activities in these policy areas.

Position can be based in selective Tetra Pak locations in Europe.

You may be required to travel 20% of your time globally.

What you will do

title: Postdoc Researcher in Resilient Edge Computing for Critical Infrastructure
employer: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
description:
The Project

This position is part of CIRES (Critical Infrastructure Resilience through Edge Computing Systems), a European research project funded under the Chips Joint Undertaking. CIRES addresses a fundamental and urgent challenge: how to design distributed digital infrastructures that remain operational, secure, and trustworthy under failures, cyber attacks, degraded connectivity, and large-scale disruptions.

Modern critical infrastructure increasingly relies on tightly coupled edge computing, distributed communication networks, and cloud coordination. While these architectures offer autonomy and scalability, they also introduce complex failure modes and new attack surfaces. CIRES develops next-generation resilient edge-cloud architectures with a focus on secure communication, distributed coordination, adaptive service continuity, and rapid recovery under adverse conditions.

The project brings together leading European research institutes, universities, and industrial partners, offering an opportunity to address scientifically challenging distributed systems problems while contributing to technologies that safeguard essential societal infrastructure.

About the Role

As a postdoctoral researcher in CIRES, you will develop network and system mechanisms that keep critical infrastructure services running when connectivity and power are degraded or disrupted. The work combines protocol and architecture design with implementation and experimental validation in real environments, together with the project's application partners.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Designing resilient network protocols and architectures that work across connectivity conditions, from well-connected, high-capacity networks to intermittently connected, delay- and disruption-tolerant networks (DTN), and adapt to the conditions at hand

    

Applying these mechanisms so that sensors, IoT and other low-power devices, user devices, and edge systems keep sufficient communication services during disruptions to communication and power infrastructure

    

Developing methods for offloading computation between end devices, edge, and cloud based on available resources and current and predicted service needs, together with efficient data collection and caching

    

Contributing to robust AI/ML and data analysis methods that support resilient decision making when only partial data is available

    

Integrating solutions with partners' software and platforms and evaluating them in large-scale tests in real environments

    

Publishing results in leading international conferences and journals

    

Contributing to EU project deliverables and technical reporting

    

Collaborating with industrial and academic partners across Europe

You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team and engage with industrial partners to validate solutions in relevant environments.

What We Offer

This position provides a strong platform for building an internationally visible research career. Specifically, you will benefit from:

    

The opportunity to publish in leading international venues in distributed systems and networking

    

Influence over technical direction within your research area

    

Access to realistic deployment environments and industrial validation scenarios

    

Participation in large-scale European research collaboration across industry and academia

    

Exposure to the full research-to-deployment pipeline within critical infrastructure contexts

    

Career development support toward senior roles in academia, research institutes, or industrial R&D

The position is a full-time, fixed-term appointment for two years, starting as soon as possible, designed to support your career development. You will gain experience in large-scale European collaboration, applied research in critical infrastructure, and direct interaction with industrial stakeholders. Travel is included in the role, primarily within Europe, with an estimated 3-4 international trips per year for consortium meetings, workshops, and conferences.

Who Are You?

Requirements:

    

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field

    

Strong background in networked and distributed systems, for example network protocols, wireless or IoT networking, or edge computing

    

Experience in system design and experimental evaluation

    

Demonstrated ability to publish scientific research

    

Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, C/C++, or equivalent)

    

Excellent written and spoken English

Meriting:

    

Experience with EU-funded research projects

    

Experience with robust or distributed AI/ML, for example federated learning

    

Experience with delay- and disruption-tolerant, opportunistic, or mesh networking

    

Familiarity with containerization, virtualization, or distributed deployment environments

    

Experience with computation offloading, caching, or edge resource management

    

Experience with testbeds or real-world deployments, including low-power IoT devices

    

Familiarity with semiconductor or embedded hardware platforms

    

Experience collaborating with industrial partners

Personal qualities:

We are looking for a researcher who combines intellectual rigour with practical systems thinking. We value:

    

Strong analytical capability and independent problem-solving

    

Ability to drive research forward with initiative and self-leadership

    

Collaborative mindset in multidisciplinary, international environments

    

Clear and structured communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

    

Curiosity, technical depth, and motivation to work on challenging problems with real-world relevance

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Univrses

Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.

The Role

In your new developer role, you will take part in building the 3DAI™ platform. It is a scalable answer to the growing demand for data about the urban environment and part of our efforts in smart city development. You will play an important role in designing, building and scaling the platform. 3DAI™ is still a young product and you will have a lot to contribute and freedom to shape the project.

    

You will be responsible for growing our platform for storing, processing and visualizing data.

    

You will use your experience to design efficient solutions for our backend and frontend systems.

    

You will have the opportunity to create innovative technologies that will change people's lives and transform the world into a better place

Who you are

    

You have at least 3+ years of experience in Fullstack software development using Node.js and Typescript on the backend, and React (Vite SPA) on the frontend.

    

You are experienced with AWS cloud platform development.

    

You have excellent general understanding of REST APIs and GraphQL.

    

You are comfortable taking high-level front-end designs and turning that into readable, maintainable, best-practice React code.

    

You can build web-services from high level specifications, including figuring out database schemas, security considerations, logging and monitoring, and how best to scale out deployments to handle lots of users and data.

    

You have an enthusiasm to tackle large-scale data challenges, with prior experience on high-performance analytic databases as a bonus.

    

You like working in a team and sharing your knowledge. You are open to giving advice and listening to feedback.

    

You are passionate about writing high-quality code and care for ensuring code validity by writing unit and integration tests.

    

You keep up-to-date with best practices and new technologies.

    

You have an aspiration to see your ideas move into production.

Bonus points

You have experience working with any of these systems or technologies:

    

Serverless computing (e.g. AWS Lambdas)

    

Familiar to infrastructure as code technologies such as Docker, AWS Cloudformation/CDK

    

Geo spatial tools and databases such as PostGIS

    

MUI (Material-UI) based front-end components

    

E2E testing frameworks like Playwright

What’s in it for You?

We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

    

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work actually matters.

    

Professional Evolution: You will be working on exciting projects involving game-changing technology with an opportunity to improve the world through autonomy and intelligence

    

The "Work-Life" Blend: Enjoy flexible work hours and a culture that values output over "desk time".

    

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

    

The Univrses Culture:

    

Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

    

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns where internal or external speakers present interesting topics, while the company pays for and caters the lunch to keep your technical and commercial skills sharp.

    

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week’s wins with our Friday After Work sessions (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!)

Are You Our Next Full Stack Engineer?

If you are a driven, creative strategist ready to shape the future of autonomous systems, we want to hear from you.

To apply, please include the following:

    

Your CV

    

A link to your LinkedIn profile

    

A brief introduction (tell us about a time you turned a challenging customer situation into a success).

Note: All application materials must be in English.

title: Project Manager Internal & External Logistics
description:
Join us in shaping the future of logistics at Nobia Park!

At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our new factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.

We are now looking for a Project Manager Internal & External Logistics to play a key role in developing and optimizing logistics processes across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.

Where we are right now

Nobia Park is continuing its journey toward becoming a highly integrated and digitally enabled manufacturing environment. As operations evolve and new capabilities are introduced, logistics plays a critical role in ensuring efficient material flow from inbound deliveries through production to outbound distribution.

In this role, you will help develop and optimize internal logistics operations, including warehousing and picking, as well as external logistics processes such as consolidation and distribution. Working closely with operations, supply chain, and IT, you will contribute to both continuous improvements and long-term development initiatives.

About the role

As Project Manager Internal & External Logistics, you will drive logistics-related projects and process development within our MES (2020 insight) and on occasions SAP/4HANA. Acting as the link between business operations and system development, you will ensure that business needs are translated into efficient and scalable logistics solutions.

Your responsibilities

Work closely with production teams to develop and implement efficient logistics flows.

    

Lead and participate in cross-functional workshops to improve processes and ways of working.

    

Provide second- and third-line support, working closely with support teams to troubleshoot issues and drive resolution.

Contribute to the development of future system and process landscapes within logistics and supply chain

    

Manage, coach, and support one direct report, ensuring clear priorities, development, and engagement.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping, this is an onsite position

Who you are

To succeed in this role, you are a structured and collaborative professional who enjoys working at the intersection of business processes, technology, and operations. You are comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments and can balance strategic thinking, project delivery, and day-to-day operational support.

You enjoy solving problems, making improvements, and creating solutions that have a real impact on business performance. You build strong relationships and communicate effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization. Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where you can influence the future design and development of logistics processes.

We believe you bring

    

At least two years' experience within Logistics, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing environments.

    

Understanding of logistics processes such as warehousing, material flow, picking, transportation, and distribution

    

Experience with process design, system configuration, or solution development within manufacturing or supply chain environments.

    

Experience working with SAP S/4HANA, preferably within Transport Management (TM), Warehouse Logistics, or related manufacturing systems.

    

Experience leading projects, process improvements, or business development initiatives

    

The ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions

    

Experience leading teams or coordinating cross-functional initiatives.

    

Fluent in both Swedish and English.

About Nobia

Then we would like to receive your application in English no later than October 18, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.
